verses.text: Sababii dubbii dhugaatiif, gad of qabiisaa fi qajeelummaatiif,

continuations.text: miidhagina keetiin moʼannaadhaan fuula duratti gulufi;
harki kee mirgaas hojii sodaachisaa haa hojjetu.

verses.text: Xiyyawwan kee qara qabeeyyiin sun onnee diinota mootii haa waraanan;

continuations.text: saboonnis miilla kee jalatti haa jijjiganii.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, teessoon kee bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ni jiraata;

continuations.text: bokkuun qajeelummaas bokkuu mootummaa keetii ni taʼa.

verses.text: Ati qajeelummaa jaallatta; jalʼina immoo ni jibbita;

continuations.text: kanaafuu Waaqayyo, Waaqni kee hiriyoota kee caalaatti,
zayitiidhaan gammachuu si dibeera.

verses.text: Uffanni kee hundinuu qumbiidhaan,

continuations.text: argeessaa fi qundhiidhaan ni urgaaʼa;
masaraawwan ilka arbaatiin miidhagfaman keessattis
muuziiqaan miʼa ribuu si gammachiisa.

verses.text: Intallan moototaa dubartoota kee warra kabajamoo keessa jiru;

continuations.text: mootittiinis warqee Oofiiriitiin miidhagfamtee
karaa harka mirga keetii dhaabatti.

verses.text: Yaa intalaa dhagaʼi; hubadhu; gurra kees as qabi;

continuations.text: saba keetii fi mana abbaa keetii irraanfadhu.

verses.text: Mootiin miidhagina kee hawwa;

continuations.text: waan inni gooftaa kee taʼeef isa kabaji.

verses.text: Intalli Xiiroos kennaa fiddee dhufti;

continuations.text: sooreyyiinis garaa si laafifachuu barbaadu.

verses.text: Intalli mootii ulfina guddaadhaan diinqa ishee jirti;

continuations.text: uffanni ishees warqeedhaan dhaʼame.

verses.text: Isheenis uffata halluu garaa garaa qabu uffattee // gara mootiitti geeffamti;

continuations.text: durboonni waaʼelli ishees ishee duukaa buʼanii // gara keetti fidamu.

verses.text: Isaanis gammachuu fi ililleedhaan ol galfamu;

continuations.text: masaraa mootichaas ni seenu.

verses.text: Ilmaan kee iddoo abbootii keetii buʼan;

continuations.text: atis lafa hunda irratti isaan ni moosifta.

verses.text: Ani akka maqaan kee dhaloota hunda keessatti yaadatamu nan godha;

continuations.text: kanaafuu saboonni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti si jajatu.

heading: Faarfannaa Cidha Mootii
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo ilmaan Qooraahi kan “Daraaraa” jedhamu. Maskiil. Faarfannaa cidhaa.

verses.text: Waaqni daʼoo fi jabina keenya;

continuations.text: inni gargaarsa yeroo hunda rakkina keessatti nu wajjin jiruu dha.

verses.text: Kanaafuu yoo lafti raafamtee

continuations.text: tulluuwwanis garaa galaanaa keessa gadi buʼan iyyuu nu hin sodaannu.

verses.text: Utuu bishaan isaas huursee hoomachaaʼee

continuations.text: tulluuwwanis raafama isaatiin sochoʼan iyyuu nu hin sodaannu.

verses.text: Lagni yaaʼaan isaa magaalaa Waaqaa gammachiisu

continuations.text: kan iddoo qulqulluu Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii jiraatuuf // gammachuu kennu tokko jira.

verses.text: Waaqni magaalattii keessa jira; isheenis hin raafamtu;

continuations.text: ganama barii Waaqni ishee gargaara.

verses.text: Saboonni ni raafaman; mootummoonnis ni kufan;

continuations.text: inni sagalee isaa dhageessise; laftis ni baqxe.

verses.text: Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu nu wajjin jira;

continuations.text: Waaqni Yaaqoob daʼoo keenya.

verses.text: Kottaa, hojii Waaqayyoo ilaalaa;

continuations.text: badiisa inni lafa irratti fides argaa.

verses.text: Inni hamma handaara lafaatti waraana ni balleessa;

continuations.text: iddaa ni cabsa; eeboo ni burkuteessa;
gaachanas ibiddaan guba.

verses.text: “Calʼisaa; akka ani Waaqa taʼes beekaa;

continuations.text: ani saboota gidduutti ol ol nan jedha;
lafa irrattis ol ol nan jedha.”

verses.text: Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu nu wajjin jira;

continuations.text: Waaqni Yaaqoob daʼoo keenya.

heading: Waaqayyo nu wajjin jira
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Haala Alaamootiitiin.

verses.text: Isin saboonni hundinuu harka keessan rukutaa;

continuations.text: sagalee ol fudhadhaatii gammachuudhaan Waaqaaf ililchaa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii,

continuations.text: Mootichi guddaan lafa hundumaa, sodaachisaadhaatii!

verses.text: Inni saboota nu jala,

continuations.text: namootas miilla keenya jala galcheera.

verses.text: Innis nu warra Yaaqoob isa inni jaallate sanaaf ulfina taaneef,

continuations.text: dhaala keenya nuu fileera.

verses.text: Waaqni ililleedhaan, Waaqayyo sagalee

continuations.text: malakataatiin ol baʼe.

verses.text: Faarfannaa galataa Waaqaaf faarfadhaa;

continuations.text: faarfannaa galataa faarfadhaa;
faarfannaa galataa Mootii keenyaaf faarfadhaa;
faarfannaa galataa faarfadhaa.

verses.text: Waaqni Mootii lafa hundaa ti;

continuations.text: faarfannaa galataa hubannaadhaan faarfadhaa.

verses.text: Waaqni saboota irratti Mootii dha;

continuations.text: Waaqni teessoo isaa qulqulluu irra taaʼeera.

verses.text: Qondaaltonni sabootaa,

continuations.text: akkuma saba Waaqa Abrahaamitti walitti qabamu;
mootonni lafa irraa kan Waaqaatii;
innis guddisee ol ol jedheera.

heading: Waaqayyo Mootii Addunyaa ti
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi.

verses.text: Magaalaa Waaqa keenyaa keessatti,

continuations.text: tulluu isaa qulqulluu irrattis, Waaqayyo guddaa dha;
waan hundaa olittis galanni isaaf mala.

verses.text: Tulluun Xiyoon gara kaabaatti argama;

continuations.text: dheerina isaatiinis ni bareeda.
Innis gammachuu addunyaa hundaa ti;
magaalaa Mooticha Guddaatis.

verses.text: Waaqni daʼannoo ishee keessa jira;

continuations.text: inni daʼannoo ishee taʼuu isaa argisiiseera.

verses.text: Mootonni humna walitti daratanii

continuations.text: tokkummaadhaan itti qajeelan.

verses.text: Isaanis ishee arganii dinqifatan;

continuations.text: sodaataniis baqatan.

verses.text: Achittis akkuma muddama dubartii ciniinsifattuutti,

continuations.text: hollannaan isaan qabate.

verses.text: Atis bubbee baʼa biiftuutiin

continuations.text: dooniiwwan Tarshiish caccabsite.

verses.text: Akkuma dhageenye sana,

continuations.text: magaalaa Waaqayyoo Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu keessatti,
magaalaa Waaqa keenyaa keessatti, akkasuma argineerra;
Waaqni bara baraan jabeessee ishee dhaaba.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, nu mana qulqullummaa kee keessatti,

continuations.text: jaalala kee kan hin geeddaramne sana irra deddeebinee yaadna.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, galanni kee akkuma maqaa keetii

continuations.text: handaara lafaa gaʼa;
harki kee mirgaas qajeelummaan guutameera.

verses.text: Sababii murtii keetiitiif,

continuations.text: Tulluun Xiyoon haa gammaddu;
intallan Yihuudaas haa ililchan.

verses.text: Xiyoon irra naannaʼaa; naannoo ishee irras adeemaa;

continuations.text: gamoowwan ishees lakkaaʼaa.

verses.text: Dhaloota itti aanutti akka himtaniif,

continuations.text: dallaa eegumsa ishee sirriitti hubadhaa;
galma ishees ilaalaa.

verses.text: Waaqni kun bara baraa hamma bara baraatti Waaqa keenyaatii;

continuations.text: inni hamma dhumaatti illee nu qajeelcha.

verses.text: Yaa namoota, isin hundi waan kana dhagaʼaa;

continuations.text: warri addunyaa kana irra jiraattan hundinuu dhaggeeffadhaa;

verses.text: xinnaa fi guddaan, sooressii fi hiyyeessi walumaan

continuations.text: dhaggeeffadhaa; kunis:

verses.text: Afaan koo dubbii ogummaa dubbata;

continuations.text: wanti ani garaatti yaadus hubannaa kenna.

verses.text: Gurra koo gara mammaaksaatti nan qabadha;

continuations.text: hibboo koos baganaadhaan nan ibsadha.

verses.text: Bara rakkinaa, yeroo gowwoomsitoonni hamoon

continuations.text: na marsanitti, ani maaliifan sodaadha?

verses.text: Isaan qabeenya isaanii amanatu;

continuations.text: guddina sooruma isaaniitiinis boonu.

verses.text: Namni lubbuu nama gara biraa furu,

continuations.text: yookaan gatii furii nama sanaa Waaqaaf baasu tokko iyyuu hin jiru;

verses.text: furiin lubbuu namaa gatii guddaa qabaatii;

continuations.text: gatiin quufsaanis yoom iyyuu hin argamu;

verses.text: silaa inni bara baraan ni jiraata;

continuations.text: hin tortorus ture.

verses.text: Akka ogeeyyiin duʼan namni hundinuu ni arga;

continuations.text: gowwoonnii fi raatuwwanis akkasuma ni badu;
qabeenya isaaniis warra kaaniif dhiisu.

verses.text: Isaan yoo lafa maqaa isaaniitiin waamamtu qabaatan illee,

continuations.text: awwaalli isaanii bara baraan mana isaanii,
dhalootaa hamma dhalootaattis iddoo boqonnaa isaanii taʼee hafa.

verses.text: Namni garuu qabeenya qabaatu illee bara dheeraa hin jiraatu;

continuations.text: inni akkuma bineensa duʼee baduu ti.

verses.text: Wanni namoota ofitti amanatanii fi

continuations.text: warra isaan duukaa buʼanii dubbii isaanii hoʼisan eeggatu kanuma.

verses.text: Isaan akkuma hoolaa duʼaaf ramadamaniiru;

continuations.text: duuti tiksee isaanii ti;
toloonni ganamaan isaan irratti aangoo qabaatu;
dhagni isaanii mana isaanii irraa fagaatee awwaala keessatti ni tortora;
awwaallis mana jireenya isaanii ti.

verses.text: Waaqni garuu lubbuu koo humna siiʼool jalaa baasa;

continuations.text: inni dhugumaan ofitti na fudhata.

verses.text: Yommuu namni tokko sooromu,

continuations.text: yommuu ulfinni mana isaas guddatu hin sodaatin.

verses.text: Inni yommuu duʼutti waanuma tokko illee fudhatee hin deemuutii;

continuations.text: ulfinni isaas isa wajjin hin dhaqu.

verses.text: Inni bara jireenya isaa lubbuu isaa eebbisu iyyuu,

continuations.text: yoo namoonni yeroo ati waan gaarii ofii keetii godhattutti si jajan illee,

verses.text: inni gara dhaloota abbootii isaa,

continuations.text: gara warra gonkumaa deebiʼanii ifa jireenyaa hin arginee ni dhaqa.

verses.text: Namni badhaadhaan hubannaa hin qabne,

continuations.text: akkuma bineensaa duʼee bada.

heading: Qabeenya abdachuun faayidaa hin qabu
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi.

verses.text: Waaqayyo, Humna Qabeessi dubbatee

continuations.text: baʼa biiftuutii jalqabee hamma lixa biiftuutti
lafa waameera.

verses.text: Xiyoon ishee miidhaginni ishee

continuations.text: hirʼina hin qabne irraa Waaqni ni ibsa.

verses.text: Waaqni keenya ni dhufa; hin calʼisus;

continuations.text: ibiddi hamaan fuula isaa dura,
bubbeen jabaanis naannoo isaa jira.

verses.text: Inni saba isaatti muruuf jedhee,

continuations.text: samiiwwan oliitii fi lafa akkana jedhee ni waama:

verses.text: “Qulqulloota koo warra aarsaadhaan na wajjin kakuu galan,

continuations.text: gara kootti walitti naa qabaa.”

verses.text: Samiiwwan qajeelummaa isaa ni labsu;

continuations.text: Waaqni mataan isaa abbaa murtiitii.

verses.text: “Yaa saba ko, nan dubbadhaatii dhagaʼi;

continuations.text: yaa Israaʼel, ani dhugaa sitti nan baʼa:
Ani Waaqni Waaqa kee ti.

verses.text: Ani aarsaa keetiif sitti hin dheekkamu;

continuations.text: aarsaan kee inni gubamu yeroo hunda fuula koo dura jira.

verses.text: Ani dallaa kee keessaa korma,

continuations.text: yookaan karra kee keessaa korbeessa reʼee hin barbaadu.

verses.text: Bineensi bosonaa hundinuu,

continuations.text: horiin tulluu kuma irratti bobbaʼus kan kootii.

verses.text: Ani simbirroota tulluuwwan irraa hunda beeka;

continuations.text: wanni lafa irra sosochoʼu hundinuus kan koo ti.

verses.text: Ani utuun beelaʼee iyyuu sitti hin himadhu ture;

continuations.text: addunyaa fi wanni ishee keessa jiru hundi kanuma kootii.

verses.text: Ani foon korommii nan nyaadhaa?

continuations.text: Yookaan dhiiga reʼootaa nan dhugaa?

verses.text: “Aarsaa galataa Waaqaaf dhiʼeessi; wareega kee illee

continuations.text: Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitiif galchi;

verses.text: guyyaa rakkinaa na waammadhu;

continuations.text: ani sin oolchaa; atis ulfina naa kennita.”

verses.text: Waaqni garuu nama hamaadhaan akkana jedha:

continuations.text: “Ati seera koo labsuudhaaf,
kakuu koos afaan keetiin dubbachuudhaaf // mirga maalii qabda?

verses.text: Ati adaba koo ni jibbita;

continuations.text: dubbii koos of duubatti gatta.

verses.text: Ati yoo hattuu argite isa michuu godhatta;

continuations.text: ejjitoota wajjinis qooda qabaatta.

verses.text: Ati afaan kee waan hamaa dubbachuuf itti fayyadamta;

continuations.text: arraba kees gowwoomsaadhaaf dheereffatta.

verses.text: Ati teessee obboleessa kee hamatta;

continuations.text: ilma haadha kee maqaa balleessita.

verses.text: Ati waan kana hunda hojjetteerta; ani immoo inuma calʼise;

continuations.text: ati akkuma ofii keetii na seete.
Amma garuu ani sin ifadha;
ifatti baasees sin himadha.

verses.text: “Isin warri Waaqa irraanfattan waan kana hubadhaa;

continuations.text: yoo kanaa achii ani isin nan ciccira;
namni isin oolchu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.

verses.text: Namni aarsaa galataa dhiʼeessu ulfina naa kenna;

continuations.text: anis warra hirʼina hin qabnetti fayyisuu Waaqaa nan argisiisa.”

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma jaalala kee

continuations.text: kan hin geeddaramne sanaatti na maari;
akkuma baayʼina araara keetiitti,
yakka koo narraa haqi.

verses.text: Yakka koo hundumaa narraa dhiqi;

continuations.text: cubbuu koo irraas na qulqulleessi.

verses.text: Ani yakka koo beekaatii;

continuations.text: cubbuun koos yeroo hunda fuula koo dura jira.

verses.text: Ani sitti, suma qofatti cubbuu hojjedheera;

continuations.text: waan fuula kee duratti hamaa taʼes hojjedheera;
kanaafuu ati murtii keetiin qajeelaa dha;
yommuu murtii kennituttis hin dogoggortu.

verses.text: Dhuguma iyyuu ani cubbuudhaanan dhaladhe;

continuations.text: yeroo haati koo na ulfooftee jalqabees cubbamaan ture.

verses.text: Ati keessa namaatti dhugaa hawwita;

continuations.text: kanaafuu keessa kootti ogummaa na barsiisi.

verses.text: Hiisophiidhaan cubbuu irraa na qulqulleessi; anis nan qulqullaaʼa;

continuations.text: na dhiqi; anis cabbii caalaatti nan addaadha.

verses.text: Gammachuu fi ilillee na dhageessisi;

continuations.text: lafeen ati caccabsites haa ililchu.

verses.text: Fuula kee cubbuu koo irraa deebifadhu;

continuations.text: yakka koo hundas narraa haqi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, garaa qulqulluu na keessatti uumi;

continuations.text: Hafuura qajeelaas na keessatti haaromsi.

verses.text: Fuula kee duraa na hin balleessin;

continuations.text: Hafuura kee Qulqulluus narraa hin fudhatin.

verses.text: Gammachuu fayyina keetii naa deebisi;

continuations.text: na jiraachisuudhaafis hafuura sarmu naa kenni.

verses.text: Anis warra karaa kee irraa jalʼatan nan barsiisa;

continuations.text: cubbamoonnis gara kee ni deebiʼu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, Waaqa na Fayyiftu,

continuations.text: ati dhiiga dhangalaasuu irraa na oolchi;
arrabni koos qajeelummaa kee ni faarfata.

verses.text: Yaa Gooftaa, hidhii koo naa bani;

continuations.text: afaan koos galata kee labsa.

verses.text: Ati aarsaatti hin gammaddu malee silaa nan dhiʼeessa ture;

continuations.text: aarsaa gubamuttis hin gammaddu.

verses.text: Aarsaan Waaqni fudhatu hafuura cabaa dha;

continuations.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati garaa cabaa fi kan gaabbu hin tuffatu.

verses.text: Jaalala keetiin Xiyooniif waan gaarii godhi;

continuations.text: dallaa Yerusaalem ijaari.

verses.text: Yoos ati aarsaa qajeelaatti, qalma gubamuu fi

continuations.text: qalma akkuma jirutti gubamutti ni gammadda;
korommiinis iddoo aarsaa kee irratti ni dhiʼeeffaman.

heading: Kadhannaa Dhiifama Cubbuu
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Faarfannaa kanas inni erga Batisheebaa bira gaʼee booddee yeroo Naataan raajichi gara isaa dhufetti faarfate.

verses.text: Yaa nama jabaa nana, ati maaliif hamminaan koorta?

continuations.text: Ati namni fuula Waaqaa duratti tuffatamtu,
maaliif guyyaa guutuu koorta?

verses.text: Ati namni nama gowwoomsitu,

continuations.text: arrabni kee badiisa qopheessa;
arrabni kee akkuma qarabaa qaramee ti.

verses.text: Ati waan gaarii irra waan hamaa jaallatta;

continuations.text: dhugaa dubbachuu irra immoo soba dubbachuu jaallatta.

verses.text: Yaa arraba gowwoomsituu nana,

continuations.text: ati dubbii nama miidhu hunda jaallatta.

verses.text: Kanaafuu Waaqni bara baraan si balleessa:

continuations.text: Inni dunkaana kee keessaa butee si ciccira;
biyya jiraattotaa keessaas si buqqisa.

verses.text: Qajeeltonni waan kana arganii sodaatan;

continuations.text: isaanis akkana jedhanii isatti kolfan;

verses.text: “Kunoo, namicha Waaqa daʼoo isaa hin godhatin,

continuations.text: qooda kanaa immoo baayʼina qabeenya isaa amanatee
jalʼina ofiitti ciche!”

verses.text: Ani garuu akkuma ejersa

continuations.text: mana Waaqaa keessatti lalisuu ti;
baraa hamma bara baraattis, jaalala Waaqaa kan
hin geeddaramne sana nan amanadha.

verses.text: Sababii ati waan kana gooteef

continuations.text: ani bara baraan sin galateeffadha;
sababii maqaan kee gaarii taʼeef ani maqaa kee nan abdadha.
Fuula qulqulloota kee durattis sin leellisa.

heading: Waan Nama Hamaa Eeggatu
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Maskiilii Daawit. Dooʼeeg namni biyya Edoomii yeroo gara Saaʼolii dhaqee, “Daawit gara mana Ahiimelekii dhufeera” jedhee itti himetti faarfatame.

verses.text: Gowwaan garaa isaatti, “Waaqni hin jiru” jedha.

continuations.text: Isaan xuraaʼaniiru; karaan isaaniis jibbisiisaa dha;
namni waan gaarii hojjetu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.

verses.text: Waaqni yoo namni waa hubatu,

continuations.text: kan Waaqas barbaadu tokko iyyuu jiraate
arguuf jedhee,
samii irraa ilmaan namootaa gad ilaala.

verses.text: Hundinuu dogoggoraniiru;

continuations.text: hundi isaaniis xuraaʼaniiru;
namni waan gaarii hojjetu tokko iyyuu hin jiru;
tokkumti iyyuu hin jiru.

verses.text: Warri hammina hojjetan,

continuations.text: kanneen akkuma waan buddeena nyaataniitti saba koo nyaatan,
warri Waaqa hin waammanne hundinuu homaa hin beekanii?

verses.text: Isaan iddoo wanni sodaatamu hin jirretti,

continuations.text: sodaadhaan liqimfamaniiru.
Waaqni lafee warra si marsanii ni bittinneessa;
sababii Waaqni isaan tuffateef, ati isaan qaanessite.

verses.text: Maaloo utuu Xiyoon keessaa fayyinni Israaʼeliif dhufee!

continuations.text: Yommuu Waaqni saba isaa warra boojiʼaman deebisutti,
Yaaqoob haa ililchu; Israaʼelis haa gammadu!

heading: Waan Warra Waaqatti Hin Bulle Eeggatu
53:1‑6 kwf – Far 14:1‑7
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Gosa Muuziiqaa maahilaati jedhamuun faarfatame. Maskiilii Daawiti.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, maqaa keetiin na fayyisi;

continuations.text: humna keetiinis naa murteessi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi,

continuations.text: dubbii afaan kootiis dhaggeeffadhu.

verses.text: Keessumoonni natti kaʼaniiruutii;

continuations.text: warri garaa namaa hin laafne lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadu;
Isaanis warra Waaqaaf ulfina hin kenninee dha.

verses.text: Kunoo, Waaqni gargaaraa koo ti;

continuations.text: Gooftaan jiraachisaa lubbuu koo ti.

verses.text: Hamminni warra maqaa na balleessanii isaanumatti haa deebiʼu;

continuations.text: atis amanamummaa keetiin isaan balleessi.

verses.text: Ani fedhii kootiin aarsaa siif dhiʼeessa;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqayyo, ani maqaa kee nan galateeffadha;
inni gaariidhaatii.

verses.text: Inni dhiphina koo hundumaa keessaa na baaseeraatii;

continuations.text: iji koos ol aantummaadhaan diinota koo of jalatti ilaaleera.

heading: Waaqayyotti Abbaa Murtii Qajeelaatti Iyyachuu
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa ribuutiin. Maskiilii Daawit. Yeroo warri Ziif Saaʼol bira dhaqanii, “Daawit nu gidduu dhokatee jira” jedhanitti faarfatame.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, kadhannaa koo dhagaʼi;

continuations.text: waammata koo jalaas hin didin.

verses.text: Na dhagaʼiitii deebii naa kenni;

continuations.text: komiin koo na dhiphisa; anis nagaa dhabeera.

verses.text: Sagalee diinaatiin,

continuations.text: cunqursa namoota hamoos dhufe;
isaan dhiphina natti fiduutii;
aariidhaanis na jibbu.

verses.text: Lapheen koo na keessatti dhiphatte;

continuations.text: sodaan duʼaas na qabate.

verses.text: Sodaa fi hollannaan natti dhufeera;

continuations.text: naasuunis na fudhateera.

verses.text: Anis akkana nan jedhe; // “Utuu ani akkuma gugee qoochoo qabaadhee!

continuations.text: Silaa asii barrisee nan boqodhan ture.

verses.text: Silaa fagootti baqadhee

continuations.text: gammoojjii keessa nan bubbula ture;

verses.text: silaa bubbee hamaa fi qilleensa jabaa irraa fagaadhee

continuations.text: gara iddoo boqonnaa kootti nan ariifadhan ture.”

verses.text: Yaa Gooftaa, namoota hamoo burjaajessi;

continuations.text: dubbii isaaniis waliin dhaʼi;
ani magaalaa keessatti goolii fi lola argeeraatii.

verses.text: Isaan halkanii guyyaa ol baʼanii dallaa ishee irra naannaʼu;

continuations.text: jalʼinnii fi rakkinni ishee keessa jira.

verses.text: Ishee keessa badiisatu jira;

continuations.text: nama cunqursuu fi gowwoomsuun daandii ishee irraa hin dhabamu.

verses.text: Utuu diinni na arrabsee,

continuations.text: silaa obsuu nan dandaʼa ture;
utuu amajaajiin natti kaʼee,
silaa jalaa dhokachuu nan dandaʼa ture.

verses.text: Garuu siʼi namuma akka kootii,

continuations.text: hiriyaa koo, michuu koo kan natti dhiʼaatutu waan kana godhe.

verses.text: Tokkummaadhaan mana Waaqaa walii wajjin deemne;

continuations.text: haasaa miʼaawaas walii wajjin haasofne.

verses.text: Duuti tasa isaanitti haa dhufu;

continuations.text: utuma lubbuudhaan jiranuu siiʼool keessa haa buʼan;
hamminni mana isaaniitii fi garaa isaanii keessa jiraattii.

verses.text: Ani garuu Waaqa nan waammadha;

continuations.text: Waaqayyos jalaa na baasa.

verses.text: Ani galgala, ganamaa fi waareetti dhiphinaan nan iyya;

continuations.text: innis sagalee koo ni dhagaʼa.

verses.text: Yoo namni baayʼeen anaan morme illee,

continuations.text: inni waraana natti kaʼe jalaa miidhaa malee na baasa.

verses.text: Waaqni inni durumaa jalqabee teessoo irra jiru sun,

continuations.text: Namoota karaa isaanii hin geeddaranne,
kanneen Waaqa hin sodaanne ni dhagaʼa;
isaan qaanessas.

verses.text: Hiriyaan koo michoota isaatti harka isaa ol fudhate;

continuations.text: kakuu isaa illee ni cabse.

verses.text: Dubbiin isaa akkuma dhadhaa ti; nama hin quuqu;

continuations.text: garaa isaa keessa garuu lolatu jira;
dubbiin isaa zayitii caalaa lallaafa;
garuu goraadee luqqifamee dha.

verses.text: Yaaddoo kee Waaqayyotti kennadhu;

continuations.text: inni si jiraachisa;
namni qajeelaan akka jeqamus hin godhu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu

continuations.text: namoota hamoo boolla badiisaa keessa ni buufta;
warri dhiiga dhangalaasanii fi gowwoomsitoonni,
walakkaa bara jireenya isaanii iyyuu hin jiraatan.
Ani garuu sin amanadha.

heading: Kadhannaa Yeroo Ariʼatamaa
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa ribuutiin. Maskiilii Daawit.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi na maari;

continuations.text: diinonni koo akka malee na ariʼu;
guyyaa guutuus na cunqursu.

verses.text: Diinonni koo guyyaa guutuu na gaadu;

continuations.text: namoonni baayʼeen of tuulummaadhaan na lolu.

verses.text: Ani yommuun sodaadhutti sin amanadha.
Waaqa ani dubbii isaa jajadhu,

continuations.text: Waaqa nan amanadha; homaa hin sodaadhu.
Namni duʼa hin oolle maal na gochuu dandaʼa?

verses.text: Isaan guyyaa guutuu dubbii koo micciiru;

continuations.text: na miidhuudhaafis yeroo hunda natti malatu.

verses.text: Isaan ni mariʼatu; ni riphus;

continuations.text: lubbuu koo galaafachuuf jedhanii
tarkaanfii koo eeggatu.

verses.text: Sababii hammina isaaniitiif akka isaan miliqan hin godhin;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqi, dheekkamsa keetiin saboota gad deebisi.

verses.text: Gadadamu koo galmeessi;

continuations.text: imimmaan koos kitaaba kee keessatti barreessi;
isaan galmee kee keessa jiru mitii?

verses.text: Yommuu ani gargaarsaaf si waammadhutti,

continuations.text: diinonni koo dugda duuba deebiʼu.
Anis kanaan akka Waaqni na wajjin jiru beeka.

verses.text: Waaqa ani dubbii isaa jajadhu,

continuations.text: Waaqayyo ani dubbii isaa jajadhu,

verses.text: Waaqa nan amanadha; ani homaa hin sodaadhu.

continuations.text: Namni maal na gochuu dandaʼa?

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi wareegni kee narra jira;

continuations.text: aarsaa galataas siif nan dhiʼeessa.

verses.text: Akka ani fuula Waaqaa dura,

continuations.text: ifa jireenyaa keessa deddeebiʼuuf,
ati lubbuu koo duʼa jalaa,
miilla koos gufachuu oolchiteertaatii.

heading: Waaqa Amanachuu
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Gugee Qilxuu Fagoo irraa” jedhuun faarfatame. Miiktaamii Faarfannaa Daawit. Innis yeroo Filisxeemonni Gaati keessatti isa qaban faarfate.

verses.text: Na maari; yaa Waaqa na maari;

continuations.text: lubbuun koo sitti kooluu galtiitii.
Anis hamma balaan darbutti,
gaaddisa qoochoo keetii jalatti kooluu nan gala.

verses.text: Ani gara Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitti,

continuations.text: gara Waaqa haaloo naa baasuutti nan iyya.

verses.text: Inni samii irraa ergee na oolcha;

continuations.text: warra akka malee na ariʼan ni ifata;
Waaqni jaalala isaatii fi amanamummaa isaa ni erga.

verses.text: Ani leencota gidduun jira;

continuations.text: ani bineensota nama nyaatan,
namoota ilkaan isaanii eeboo fi xiyyaa
kanneen arrabni isaanii akka goraadee qaramaa gidduu ciiseera.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati samiiwwaniin olitti ol ol jedhi;

continuations.text: ulfinni kees lafa hunda irra haa jiraatu.

verses.text: Isaanis kiyyoo miilla kootiif kaaʼan;

continuations.text: lubbuun koos dhiphinaan gad gogdeerti.
Isaan karaa koo irratti boolla qotan;
garuu isaanumattu keessatti kufe.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, garaan koo hin raafamu;

continuations.text: garaan koo hin raafamu;
ani nan faarfadha; nan weeddisas.

verses.text: Yaa lubbuu ko, dammaqi!

continuations.text: Yaa kiraaraa fi baganaa dammaqaa!
Anis ganamaan nan dammaqa.

verses.text: Yaa Gooftaa, ani saboota gidduutti galata siif nan galcha;

continuations.text: namoota gidduuttis waaʼee kee nan faarfadha.

verses.text: Jaalalli kee guddaa dha; samiiwwanis gaʼaatii;

continuations.text: amanamummaan kees samiiwwan qaqqaba.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati samiiwwaniin olitti ol ol jedhi;

continuations.text: ulfinni kees lafa hunda irra haa jiraatu.

heading: Diinota Gara Jabeeyyii Gidduutti
57:7‑11 kwf – Far 108:1‑5
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Faarfannaa Daawit. Miiktaamii. Innis yeroo Saaʼol jalaa baqatee holqatti galee faarfate.

verses.text: Yaa bulchitoota, isin dhugumaan waan qajeelaa dubbattanii?

continuations.text: Nama gidduuttis murtii qajeelaa kennitanii?

verses.text: Akkas miti; isin garaa keessan keessatti hammina yaaddu;

continuations.text: harki keessanis lafa irratti goolii kaasa.

verses.text: Namoonni hamoon dhalootumaa kaasanii karaa irraa jalʼatu;

continuations.text: gadameessa haadha isaaniitii jalqabniis karaa irraa goranii soba dubbatu.

verses.text: Hadhaan isaanii akkuma hadhaa bofaa ti;

continuations.text: isaan akkuma buutii duudaa gurra isaa cuqqaalatee

verses.text: sagalee nama isa raatessuu yookaan nama waan ittiin isa raatessu

continuations.text: hojjetu tokkoo dhagaʼuu diduu ti.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi ati ilkaan isaanii afaan isaanii keessatti caccabsi;

continuations.text: qarriffaa leencotaas daaki, yaa Waaqayyo!

verses.text: Isaan akkuma bishaan dhangalaʼee baduutti haa badan;

continuations.text: yeroo iddaa futtaasanitti xiyyi isaanii haa doomu.

verses.text: Akkuma ciilalluu yommuu deemu baquutti,

continuations.text: akkuma daaʼima utuu yeroon hin gaʼin dhalatuuttis aduu hin argin.

verses.text: Utuu okkoteen keessan ibidda qoraattiitiin hin hoʼin,

continuations.text: jiidhaas taʼu gogaan isaanii haxaaʼamanii balleeffamu.

verses.text: Namni qajeelaan yommuu haaloo baʼuu kana argutti ni gammada;

continuations.text: miilla isaas dhiiga namoota hamootiin ni dhiqata.

verses.text: Yommus namoonni akkana ni jedhu;

continuations.text: “Dhugumaan nama qajeelaadhaaf badhaasni jira;
dhugumaan Waaqni lafa irratti murtii kennu jira.”

heading: Abbaa Murtii Kan Abbootii Murtii Biyya Lafaa
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Faarfannaa Daawiti. Miiktaamii.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, diinota koo jalaa na baasi;

continuations.text: warra natti kaʼan jalaas na furi.

verses.text: Warra hammina hojjetan jalaa na baasi;

continuations.text: namoota dhiiga dhangalaasan jalaas na baraari.

verses.text: Ilaa, isaan riphanii na eeggachaa jiruu!

continuations.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, namoonni hamoon,
utuu ani balleessaa fi cubbuu hin qabaatin lola natti kaasu.

verses.text: Ani balleessaa tokko illee hin hojjennee;

continuations.text: isaan garuu na loluuf qophaaʼaniiru.
Na gargaaruudhaaf kaʼi; rakkina koos ilaali!

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu,

continuations.text: yaa Waaqa Israaʼel, saboota hunda adabuudhaaf kaʼi;
warra hammina isaaniitiin yakka hojjetan tokko illee hin maarin.

verses.text: Isaanis galgala galgala deebiʼanii,

continuations.text: akka saree gururiʼaa magaalattii irra naannaʼu.

verses.text: Waan isaan afaan isaaniitii baasan ilaali;

continuations.text: hidhii isaanii irra goraadeetu jira;
isaanis, “Eenyutu nu dhagaʼuu dandaʼa?” jedhu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu isaanitti kolfita;

continuations.text: saboota sana hundumattis ni qoosta.

verses.text: Yaa Jabina ko, ani sin eeggadha;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqi ati daʼoo koo,

verses.text: Waaqa na jaallatuu dha.

continuations.text: Waaqni fuula koo dura deema;
akka ani diinota koo moʼannoodhaan of jalatti ilaalu godha.

verses.text: Yaa Gooftaa, yaa gaachana keenya,

continuations.text: ati garuu isaan hin ajjeesin;
yoo kanaa achii sabni koo ni irraanfata.
Humna keetiin akka isaan jooran godhi; gad isaan deebisis.

verses.text: Sababii cubbuu afaan isaaniitiif,

continuations.text: sababii dubbii hidhii isaaniitiif,
isaan of tuulummaa isaaniitiin haa qabaman.
Sababii abaarsaa fi soba isaan dubbataniitiif,

verses.text: dheekkamsaan isaan balleessi;

continuations.text: akka isaan deebiʼanii hin argamneef isaan balleessi.
Kanaanis akka Waaqni Yaaqoob irratti mootii taʼe,
hamma handaara lafaatti ni beekama.

verses.text: Isaanis galgala galgala deebiʼanii,

continuations.text: akka saree gururiʼaa, magaalattii irra naannaʼu.

verses.text: Isaan waan nyaatan barbaacha asii fi achi jooru;

continuations.text: yoo quufuu baatan immoo ni iyyu.

verses.text: Ani garuu waaʼee jabina keetii nan faarfadha;

continuations.text: ganamaanis waaʼee jaalala keetii nan faarfadha;
ati daʼoo kootii; yeroo rakkina koottis
ati iddoo ani itti kooluu galuu dha.

verses.text: Yaa Jabina ko, ani faarfannaa galataa siifin faarfadha;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqi, ati daʼoo koo ti;
ati Waaqa ani abdadhuu dha.

heading: Kadhannaa Diina Jalaa Baʼuuf Dhiʼaate
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo Daawit kan “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Miiktaamii. Daawitis yeroo Saaʼol isa ajjeesuudhaaf jedhee namoota ergee mana isaa eegsisetti faarfate.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati nu gatteerta; nu caccabsiteertas;

continuations.text: nutti aarteerta; amma garuu iddootti nu deebisi!

verses.text: Ati lafa sochoofteerta; tarsaaftees afaan bansiifteerta;

continuations.text: caccabaa ishees walitti suphi; isheen raafamteertii.

verses.text: Ati akka sabni kee waan hamaadhaan dhiphatu gooteerta;

continuations.text: daadhii wayinii nu gatantarsus nuu kenniteerta.

verses.text: Akka isaan iddaa jalaa gara isaatti baqataniif,

continuations.text: ati warra si sodaataniif mallattoo kenniteerta.

verses.text: Akka warri ati jaallattu furamaniif,

continuations.text: harka kee mirgaatiin nu oolchi; nu gargaaris.

verses.text: Waaqni iddoo qulqullummaa isaatii akkana jedhee dubbateera;

continuations.text: “Ani gammachuudhaan Sheekemin gargar nan qooda;
Sulula Sukootis nan safara.

verses.text: Giliʼaad kan koo ti; Minaaseenis kan koo ti.

continuations.text: Efreem gonfoo sibiilaa koo ti;
Yihuudaanis bokkuu mootummaa koo ti.

verses.text: Moʼaab caabii dhiqannaa koo ti;

continuations.text: Edoom irra kophee koo darbadhee nan buusa;
Filisxeem irrattis moʼannaadhaan nan geerara.”

verses.text: Eenyutu magaalaa jabeeffamtee ijaaramtetti na fida?

continuations.text: Eenyutu Edoomitti na geessa?

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, kan nu gatte suma mitii?

continuations.text: Yaa Waaqi, kan loltoota keenya wajjin baʼuu diddes suma mitii?

verses.text: Diina keenya of irraa dhowwuu nu gargaar;

continuations.text: gargaarsi namaa faayidaa hin qabuutii.

verses.text: Nu Waaqa wajjin ni moʼanna;

continuations.text: innis diinota keenya gad dhidhiita.

heading: Kadhannaa Moʼamuu Booddee Dhiʼeeffame

Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Daraaraa kakuu” jedhamuun faarfatame. Miiktaamii Daawit. Barsiisuuf. Yeroo inni Arraam Nahaaraayimii fi Arraam Zoobaa lolee fi yeroo Yooʼaabin deebisee warra Edoomii keessaa namoota kuma kudha lama Sulula soogiddaa keessatti fixetti faarfatame.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, iyyata koo dhagaʼi;

continuations.text: kadhannaa koos dhaggeeffadhu.

verses.text: Yeroo garaan koo citetti,

continuations.text: ani handaara lafaatii sin waammadha;
ati gara kattaa na caalaa ol dheeratuutti na geessi.

verses.text: Ati iddoo ani itti kooluu galuudhaatii;

continuations.text: fuula diina koo durattis gamoo jabaa dha.

verses.text: Ani bara baraan dunkaana kee keessa jiraachuu,

continuations.text: gaaddisa qoochoo keetii jalattis kooluu galuu nan hawwa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati wareega koo dhageesseertaatii;

continuations.text: dhaala warri maqaa kee sodaatan argatanis naa kenniteerta.

verses.text: Bara jireenya mootii, umurii isaa illee

continuations.text: dhalootaa gara dhalootaatti dheeressi.

verses.text: Innis fuula Waaqaa duratti bara baraan haa moʼu;

continuations.text: akka jaalalli keetii fi amanamummaan kee isa eeganis godhi.

verses.text: Anis faarfannaa galataa maqaa keetiif nan faarfadha;

continuations.text: guyyuma guyyaanis wareega koo nan guuttadha.

heading: Faarfannaa Nama Boojiʼamee
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit kan miʼa ribuutiin faarfatame.

verses.text: Lubbuun koo Waaqa qofa eeggatti;

continuations.text: fayyinni koos isa biraa naa dhufa.

verses.text: Kattaan kootii fi fayyinni koo isa qofa;

continuations.text: inni daʼoo koo ti; ani gonkumaa hin raafamu.

verses.text: Isin hamma yoomiitti nama miitu?

continuations.text: Hamma yoomiitti akka keenyan manaa kan duufeetti,
akka dallaa raafameettis lafaan isa dhaʼuu barbaaddu?

verses.text: Isaan aangoo isaa guddaa sana irraa,

continuations.text: guutummaatti gad isa deebisuu barbaadu;
isaan sobatti ni gammadu.
Afaan isaaniitiin ni eebbisu;
garaa isaaniitiin garuu ni abaaru.

verses.text: Lubbuun koo Waaqa qofa obsaan eeggatti;

continuations.text: abdiin koo isa biraa dhufaatii.

verses.text: Kattaan kootii fi fayyinni koo isa qofa;

continuations.text: inni daʼoo koo ti; ani hin raafamu.

verses.text: Fayyinni kootii fi ulfinni koo harka Waaqaa keessa jira;

continuations.text: kattaan koo jabaan, iddoon ani itti kooluu galu Waaqa.

verses.text: Yaa namoota, yeroo hunda isa amanadhaa;

continuations.text: garaa keessanis fuula isaa duratti dhangalaasaa;
Waaqni iddoo nu itti kooluu galluudhaatii.

verses.text: Gosa tuffatamaa irraa dhalachuun homaa miti;

continuations.text: gosa kabajamaa irraa dhalachuunis sobuma;
yoo madaaliidhaan madaalaman
lachanuu qilleensa caalaa salphatu.

verses.text: Waan saamichaan argattan hin amanatinaa;

continuations.text: waan hatameenis hin koorinaa.
Yoo qabeenyi keessan guddate illee,
qalbii keessan isa irra hin kaaʼatinaa.

verses.text: Waaqni yeroo tokko dubbate;

continuations.text: ani immoo yeroo lama nan dhagaʼe;
kunis akka humni kan Waaqaa taʼee dha.

verses.text: Yaa Gooftaa araarri kan kee ti.

continuations.text: Ati dhugumaan tokkoo tokkoo namaa
akkuma hojii isaatti gatii isaa ni kennitaaf.

heading: Waaqa Qofa Abdachuu
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeduutuuniif. Faarfannaa Daawit.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati Waaqa koo ti;

continuations.text: ani dhugumaan sin barbaadadha;
lafa gogaa fi gammoojjii,
lafa bishaan hin jirretti,
lubbuun koo si dheebotti;
foon koos sitti gaggaba.

verses.text: Kanaafuu ani iddoo qulqulluu keessattin si arge;

continuations.text: humna keetii fi ulfina kees nan ilaale.

verses.text: Waan jaalalli kee jireenya caaluuf,

continuations.text: hidhiin koo si jajatti.

verses.text: Ani hamman jirutti sin eebbisa;

continuations.text: maqaa keetiinis harka koo ol nan qabadha.

verses.text: Lubbuun koo akka nama dhukaa fi cooma quufeetti quufti;

continuations.text: afaan koos hidhii ililleetiin si jajata.

verses.text: Ani siree koo irratti sin yaadadha;

continuations.text: halkan guutuus waaʼee kee nan yaada.

verses.text: Waan ati gargaarsa koo taateef,

continuations.text: ani gaaddisa qoochoo keetii jalatti gammachuudhaan nan faarfadha.

verses.text: Lubbuun koo sitti maxxanti;

continuations.text: harki kee mirgaa ol na qaba.

verses.text: Warri lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadan garuu

continuations.text: boolla lafaa isa gad fagoo keessa buʼu.

verses.text: Isaan dabarfamanii goraadeetti kennamu;

continuations.text: nyaata waangoos ni taʼu.

verses.text: Mootiin garuu Waaqaatti ni gammada;

continuations.text: namni Waaqaan kakatu hundinuu ulfina argata;
afaan warra soba dubbatuu immoo ni cufama.

heading: Waaqa Barbaacha
Faarfannaa Daawit. Yeroo inni Gammoojjii Yihuudaa keessa turetti.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, yommuu ani iyyadhu sagalee koo dhagaʼi;

continuations.text: lubbuu koos doorsisuu diinaa duraa baasi.

verses.text: Marii jalʼootaa duraa,

continuations.text: mala namoota hamoo duraas na dhoksi.

verses.text: Isaan arraba isaanii akka goraadee qaratan;

continuations.text: dubbii hadhaaʼaas akkuma xiyyaatti qopheeffatu.

verses.text: Isaan riphanii nama yakka hin qabnetti futtaasu;

continuations.text: akkuma tasaas sodaa malee itti gad dhiisu.

verses.text: Kaayyoo jalʼinaa irratti wal jajjabeessu;

continuations.text: waaʼee dhoksanii kiyyoo kaaʼuus ni mariʼatu;
“Eenyutu isa arguu dandaʼa?” jedhaniis ni yaadu.

verses.text: Isaanis jalʼina yaaduudhaan,

continuations.text: “Nu mala hirʼina hin qabne malanneerra!” jedhu;
yaadnii fi keessi garaa namaa gad fagoodhaatii.

verses.text: Waaqni garuu xiyya isaa isaanitti futtaasa;

continuations.text: isaanis akkuma tasaa madaaʼu.

verses.text: Innis arrabuma isaaniin isaan balleessa;

continuations.text: warri isaan argan hundinuu tuffiidhaan mataa raasu.

verses.text: Namoonni hundinuu ni sodaatu;

continuations.text: isaan hojii Waaqaa ni labsu;
waan inni hojjete illee ni qalbeeffatu.

verses.text: Namni qajeelaan Waaqayyotti gammada;

continuations.text: isattis kooluu gala;
gara toleeyyiin hundinuu isaan ulfina argatu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, Xiyoon keessatti galatatu si eeggata;

continuations.text: wareegni keenyas siif galfama.

verses.text: Yaa isa kadhannaa namaa dhageessu,

continuations.text: namni hundinuu gara kee ni dhufa.

verses.text: Yeroo cubbuun na moʼattetti,

continuations.text: ati yakka keenya nuu dhiifteerta.

verses.text: Warri ati filattee akka isaan qeʼee kee jiraataniif

continuations.text: ofitti dhiʼeessite eebbifamoo dha!
Nus waan gaarii mana keetiitiin,
kan mana qulqullummaa keetiitiinis ni quufna.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi Fayyisaa keenya,

continuations.text: ati hojii qajeelummaa sodaachisaadhaan // deebii nuu kennita;
daarii lafaa hundumaaf,
galaana fagootti argamuufis ati abdii dha;

verses.text: ati humna uffatteerta;

continuations.text: jabina keetiinis tulluuwwan hundeessite;

verses.text: ati huursaa galaanaa,

continuations.text: huursaa dhaʼaa bishaanii,
raafama uummataas ni calʼisiifte.

verses.text: Warri fagoo jiraatan dinqiiwwan kee ni sodaatu;

continuations.text: ati yeroo bariʼuu fi yeroo dhiʼutti,
akka faarfannaan gammachuu faarfatamu ni goota.

verses.text: Ati lafa ni eegda; bishaanis ni obaafta;

continuations.text: akka malees ni gabbifta;
akka namootaaf midhaan kennaniifis
lageen Waaqaa bishaaniin guutamaniiru;
ati kanumaaf qopheessiteertaatii.

verses.text: Boʼoo isaa bishaan quubsita;

continuations.text: biyyoo isaas wal qixxeessita;
tiifuu bokkaatiinis ni jiifta;
biqila isaas ni eebbifta.

verses.text: Gaarummaa keetiin bara ni gonfita;

continuations.text: daandiiwwan kees cooma coccobsu.

verses.text: Lafti margaa kan gammoojjii akka malee misa;

continuations.text: gaarranis gammachuudhaan guutamu.

verses.text: Dirreewwan bushaayeedhaan guutamu;

continuations.text: sululoonni midhaaniin haguugamu;
isaanis ililleedhaan iyyanii faarfatu.

verses.text: Isin lafti hundinuu ililleedhaan gara Waaqaatti iyyaa!
Ulfina maqaa isaa faarfadhaa;

continuations.text: galata isaatiifis ulfina kennaa!

verses.text: Waaqaan akkana jedhaa;

continuations.text: “Hojiin kee akkam sodaachisaa dha!
Sababii humni kee guddaa taʼeef,
diinonni kee fuula kee duratti hollatu.

verses.text: Lafti hundinuu siif sagadu;

continuations.text: faarfannaa galataa siif faarfatu;
maqaa keetiifis faarfatu.”

verses.text: Kottaatii waan Waaqni hojjete,

continuations.text: hojii sodaachiisaa inni namaaf hojjete ilaalaa!

verses.text: Inni galaana lafa gogaatti geeddare;

continuations.text: isaanis miilla isaaniitiin laga ceʼan;
kottaa isatti haa gammannu!

verses.text: Inni bara baraan humna isaatiin bulcha;

continuations.text: iji isaas saboota ilaala;
finciltoonni ol ol of hin qabin.

verses.text: Yaa saboota, Waaqa keenya eebbisaa;

continuations.text: sagaleen isa galateeffatus haa dhagaʼamu;

verses.text: inni lubbuu keenya jiraachiseera;

continuations.text: miilla keenyas mucucaachuu oolcheera.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati nu qorteertaatii;

continuations.text: akkuma meetiis nu qulqulleessiteerta.

verses.text: Ati kiyyootti nu galchiteerta;

continuations.text: dugda keenya irras baʼaa keesseerta.

verses.text: Akka namoonni mataa keenya yaabbatan gooteerta;

continuations.text: nu ibiddaa fi bishaan keessa dabarre;
ati garuu iddoo badhaadhummaatti nu fidde.

verses.text: Anis qalma gubamu qabadhee // mana qulqullummaa kee nan seena;

continuations.text: wareega koos siif nan galcha;

verses.text: kunis wareega yeroo ani rakkina keessa turetti

continuations.text: arrabni koo waadaa galee afaan koos dubbatee dha.

verses.text: Anis horii coccoomoo, qalma gubamu,

continuations.text: korbeeyyii hoolaa immoo aarsaa godhee siif nan dhiʼeessa;
jibootaa fi reʼoota illee aarsaa siifin dhiʼeessa.

verses.text: Isin warri Waaqa sodaattan hundi kottaa dhaggeeffadhaa;

continuations.text: anis waan inni naaf godhe isinitti nan hima.

verses.text: Ani afaan kootiin isatti nan iyye;

continuations.text: galanni isaas arraba koo irra ture.

verses.text: Utuu ani garaa koo keessa cubbuu kaaʼadhee jiraadhee,

continuations.text: silaa Gooftaan naaf hin dhagaʼu ture;

verses.text: Waaqni garuu dhugumaan na dhaggeeffateera;

continuations.text: sagalee kadhannaa kootiis dhagaʼeera.

verses.text: Waaqni kadhannaa koo hin didin

continuations.text: yookaan jaalala isaa na hin dhowwatin haa eebbifamu!

verses.text: Waaqni garaa nuuf laafu; nu haa eebbisus;

continuations.text: fuula isaas nurratti haa ibsu;

verses.text: kunis akka karaan kee lafa irratti,

continuations.text: fayyisuun kee immoo saboota hundumaa biratti beekamuuf.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, saboonni si haa jajatan;

continuations.text: saboonni hundii si haa jajatan.

verses.text: Ati waan qajeelummaadhaan namoota bulchituuf,

continuations.text: saboota lafa irraas waan geggeessituuf,
saboonni haa gammadanis; ililchaniis haa faarfatan.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, saboonni si haa jajatan;

continuations.text: saboonni hundii si haa jajatan.

verses.text: Lafti midhaan kenniteerti;

continuations.text: Waaqayyo Waaqni keenyas nu eebbiseera.

verses.text: Waaqni nu eebbiseera;

continuations.text: handaarri lafaa hundi isa haa sodaatu.

heading: Faarfannaa Yeroo Midhaan Galfamuu
Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa ribuutiin. Faarfannaa.

verses.text: Waaqni haa kaʼu; diinonni isaas haa bittinnaaʼan;

continuations.text: warri isa jibbanis fuula isaa duraa haa baqatan.

verses.text: Akkuma aarri bittinnaaʼu, ati isaan bittinneessi;

continuations.text: akkuma gagaan ibidda duratti baqu,
hamoonni fuula Waaqaa duraa haa badan.

verses.text: Qajeelonni garuu haa gammadan;

continuations.text: fuula Waaqaa durattis baayʼee haa gammadan;
isaan gammachuudhaan haa ililchan.

verses.text: Waaqaaf faarfadhaa;

continuations.text: faarfannaa galataa maqaa isaatiif faarfadhaa;
isa duumessaan gulufu sana jajadhaa;
maqaan isaa Waaqayyoo dha;
fuula isaa durattis baayʼee gammadaa.

verses.text: Waaqni warra abbaa hin qabneef abbaa,

continuations.text: niitota dhirsoonni irraa duʼaniifis falmaa taʼe sun
iddoo jireenya isaa qulqulluu keessa jira.

verses.text: Waaqni warra kophaa taʼan maatii keessa jiraachisa;

continuations.text: warra hidhamanis mana hidhaatii baasa;
finciltoonni garuu lafa gogaa irra jiraatu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, gaafa ati saba kee dura baate,

continuations.text: gaafa ati gammoojjii keessa dabarte,

verses.text: fuula Waaqaa, Waaqa Siinaa duratti,

continuations.text: fuula Waaqaa, Waaqa Israaʼel duratti,
lafti ni raafamte; samiiwwanis bokkaa roobsan.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati bokkaa baayʼee roobsite;

continuations.text: dhaala kee kan dadhabe illee ni quubsite.

verses.text: Sabni kee achi qubate;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqayyo, ati badhaadhummaa kee keessaa // hiyyeeyyii soorte.

verses.text: Gooftaan dubbii isaa kenne;

continuations.text: dubartoonni dubbii sana labsanis baayʼee dha:

verses.text: “Mootonnii fi loltoonni ariitiin baqatan;

continuations.text: dubartoonni qeʼee oolan boojuu qooddatan.

verses.text: Yoo gola hoolotaa gidduutti argamtan illee,

continuations.text: isin akka gugee qoochoon ishee meetiidhaan uffifamee
baalleen ishee immoo warqee calaqqisuun uffifamee ti.”

verses.text: Yommuu Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu

continuations.text: mootota achitti bittinneessetti, // Zalmoon irratti cabbiin buʼe.

verses.text: Yaa tulluu Baashaan, yaa tulluu surra qabeessa,

continuations.text: yaa Tulluu Baashaan, yaa tulluu fiixee baayʼee qabu,

verses.text: yaa tulluu fiixee baayʼee qabdu,

continuations.text: ati maaliif tulluu Waaqni bulchuuf filate,
iddoo Waaqayyo bara baraan jiraatu sana // hinaaffaadhaan ilaalta?

verses.text: Gaariiwwan Waaqaa kuma hedduu dha;

continuations.text: isaan kumaatama yeroo kumaatamaa ti;
Gooftaanis Siinaadhaa gara iddoo qulqulluu dhufeera.

verses.text: Ati yommuu ol gubbaa baatetti

continuations.text: boojuu baayʼee fudhate;
yaa Waaqayyo, yaa Waaqi, ati achi jiraachuuf jettee,
namoota irraa, finciltoota irraas kennaa fudhatte.

verses.text: Gooftaan guyyuma guyyaan baʼaa keenya baatu,

continuations.text: Waaqni Fayyissaa keenya taʼe sun haa eebbifamu.

verses.text: Waaqni keenya Waaqa fayyinaa ti; duʼa jalaa baʼuunis

continuations.text: Waaqayyo Goofticha biraa dhufa.

verses.text: Waaqni dhugumaan mataa diina isaa,

continuations.text: gubbee mataa warra cubbuu isaaniitti fufanii // kan rifeensa qabu ni caccabsa.

verses.text: Gooftaan akkana jedha; “Ani deebisee Baashaanii isaan nan fida;

continuations.text: tuujuba galaanaa keessaas deebisee isaan nan fida;

verses.text: kunis akka ati dhiiga diinota keetii miilla keetiin borcituuf;

continuations.text: arrabni saroota keetiis akka qooda isaanii qabaatuuf.”

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, hiriirri kee mulʼateera;

continuations.text: hiriirri Waaqa kootiitii fi mootii kootii iddoo qulqulluutti ol galeera.

verses.text: Fuula duraan faarfattoota,

continuations.text: dugda duubaan immoo warra muuziiqaa taphatantu ture;
dubartoonni dibbee rukutanis gidduu isaanii turan.

verses.text: Waldaa guddaa keessatti Waaqa jajadhaa;

continuations.text: yaaʼii Israaʼel keessattis Waaqayyoon jajadhaa.

verses.text: Beniyaam gosti xinnichi isaan dura deema;

continuations.text: tuunni ilmaan mootota Yihuudaas achi turan;
ilmaan mootota Zebuuloonii fi Niftaalemis achi turan.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, humna kee ajaji;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqa keenya, akkuma duraan goote sana // jabina kee nu argisiisi.

verses.text: Sababii mana qulqullummaa keetii kan Yerusaalem keessaatiif

continuations.text: mootonni kennaa siif fidu.

verses.text: Bineensota shambaqqoo keessaa,

continuations.text: karra korommii jabboota sabootaa keessaas ifadhu.
Warra meetii fidan gad deebisi.
Warra waraanatti gammadanis bittinneessi.

verses.text: Ergamoonni Gibxi ni dhufu;

continuations.text: Itoophiyaanis daftee harka ishee Waaqatti balʼifatti.

verses.text: Yaa mootummoota lafaa, Waaqa faarfadhaa;

continuations.text: faarfannaa galataas Gooftaadhaaf faarfadhaa;

verses.text: isa samiiwwan durii keessa gulufu,

continuations.text: isa sagalee jabaadhaan qaqawweessaʼu sana faarfadhaa.

verses.text: Waaqa ulfinni isaa Israaʼel irra jiru,

continuations.text: isa miidhaginni isaa
samiiwwan keessa jiru sana humna isaa labsaa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati iddoo qulqullummaa keetiitti sodaachisaa dha;

continuations.text: Waaqni Israaʼel saba isaatiif humnaa fi jabina ni kenna.
Waaqni haa eebbifamu!

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati na baasi;

continuations.text: bishaan ol dhufee morma na gaʼeeraatii.

verses.text: Ani raaree keessa, lafa iddoon miilla dhaabatan

continuations.text: hin jirre keessa seeneera.
Ani tuujuba bishaanii keessa seeneera;
lolaanis narra garagaleera.

verses.text: Ani iyyuudhaan dadhabeera;

continuations.text: laagaan koo babbaqaqeera;
iji koo, Waaqa koo eeggachuudhaan dadhabeera.

verses.text: Warri lafumaa kaʼanii na jibban

continuations.text: rifeensa mataa kootii caalaa baayʼatu;
warri na ajjeesuu barbaadan,
warri akkasumaan diina koo taʼan baayʼee dha.
Ani akkan waan hin hatin
deebisu dirqameera.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati gowwummaa koo ni beekta;

continuations.text: yakki koos si duraa hin dhokatu.

verses.text: Yaa Gooftaa, Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandeessu,

continuations.text: warri abdii sirra kaaʼatan,
sababii kootiif hin qaanaʼin;
yaa Waaqa Israaʼel, warri si barbaadan,
sababii kootiif hin qaaneffamin.

verses.text: Ani siif jedhee tuffii obseeraatii;

continuations.text: qaaniinis fuula koo haguugeera.

verses.text: Ani obboloota kootti keessummaa,

continuations.text: ilmaan haadha kootiittis alagaa dha;

verses.text: Hinaaffaan mana keetii na guggubeeraatii;

continuations.text: arrabsoon warra si arrabsaniis narra buʼeera.

verses.text: Booʼuu fi soomuun koo,

continuations.text: arrabsoo natti taʼe.

verses.text: Yommuu ani wayyaa gaddaa uffadhetti,

continuations.text: namoonni natti qoosu.

verses.text: Warri karra dura tataaʼan natti qoosu;

continuations.text: machooftonnis waaʼee kootiin sirbu.

verses.text: Ani garuu yaa Waaqayyo,

continuations.text: yeroo ati filattutti sin kadhadha;
yaa Waaqi, jaalala kee guddichaan
fayyina kee kan dhugaatiinis deebii naaf kenni.

verses.text: Akka ani hin liqimfamneef,

continuations.text: raaree keessaa na baasi;
warra na jibban jalaa,
bishaanota gad fagoo keessaas na baasi.

verses.text: Ati akka lolaan na hin fudhanne,

continuations.text: akka tuujubni na hin liqimsine,
akka boollis afaan isaa natti hin cufanne godhi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, gaarummaa jaalala keetiitiin // deebii naaf kenni;

continuations.text: araara kee guddichaanis natti garagali.

verses.text: Fuula kee tajaajilaa kee duraa hin dhokfatin;

continuations.text: waan ani rakkina keessa jiruuf dafiitii deebii naaf kenni.

verses.text: Natti dhiʼaadhuutii na furi;

continuations.text: xiiqii diinota kootiif jedhii na baasi.

verses.text: Ati akka ani hammam tuffatamee,

continuations.text: salphifamee fi akka ani qaaneffame ni beekta;
diinonni koo hundinuus fuula koo dura jiru.

verses.text: Arrabsoon garaa koo cabse;

continuations.text: anis abdii kutadheera.
Ani nama garaa naaf laafu nan barbaade; garuu nan dhabe;
nama na jajjabeessus nan barbaade; // garuu tokko illee hin arganne.

verses.text: Nyaata kootti hadhooftuu makan;

continuations.text: akka ani dhuguuf immoo waan dhangaggaaʼaa naa kennan.

verses.text: Maaddiin isaanii iddaa isaanitti haa taʼu;

continuations.text: adabaa fi kiyyoo isaanitti haa taʼu.

verses.text: Akka arguu hin dandeenyeef iji isaanii haa haguuggamu;

continuations.text: dugdi isaaniis bara baraan haa goophatu.

verses.text: Dheekkamsa kee isaan irratti dhangalaasi;

continuations.text: aariin kee bobaʼaan sunis isaan irra haa buʼu.

verses.text: Qeʼeen isaanii haa onu;

continuations.text: namni dunkaana isaanii keessa jiraatu tokko iyyuu hin hafin.

verses.text: Isaan warra ati madeessite sana ni ariʼatuutii;

continuations.text: waaʼee dhukkubbii warra ati miite sanaas ni odeessu.

verses.text: Yakka irratti yakka isaanitti dabali;

continuations.text: isaan gara qajeelumma keetii hin dhufin.

verses.text: Maqaan isaanii kitaaba jireenyaa keessaa haa haqamu;

continuations.text: qajeeltota wajjinis hin galmeeffamin.

verses.text: Ani garuu dhiphinaa fi rakkina keessan jira;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqi, fayyinni kee ol na haa qabu.

verses.text: Ani faarfannaadhaan maqaa Waaqaa nan galateeffadha;

continuations.text: galataanis ulfina nan kennaaf.

verses.text: Kunis sangaa caalaa, korma gaanfaa fi

continuations.text: kottee qabu dhiʼeessuu caalaa Waaqayyoon gammachiisa.

verses.text: Hiyyeeyyiin waan kana arganii ni gammadu;

continuations.text: isin warri Waaqa barbaaddan garaan keessan jiraata haa taʼu!

verses.text: Waaqayyo rakkattoota ni dhagaʼa;

continuations.text: namoota isaa warra hidhamanis hin tuffatu.

verses.text: Samii fi lafti, galaanonnii fi

continuations.text: wanni isaan keessa jiraatan hundinuu isa haa leellissan.

verses.text: Waaqni Xiyoonin ni fayyisaatii;

continuations.text: magaalaawwan Yihuudaas deebisee ni ijaara.
Sabni isaas achi qubata; ni dhaalas.

verses.text: Sanyiin tajaajiltoota isaa magaalattii ni dhaalu;

continuations.text: warri maqaa isaa jaallatanis achi jiraatu.

heading: Faaruu Booʼichaa
Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Daraaraatiin.” Faarfannaa Daawit.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, na fayyisuuf ariifadhu;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqayyo, na gargaaruuf dafii kottu.

verses.text: Warri lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadan

continuations.text: hundinuu, haa qaanaʼan; haa burjaajaʼanis;
warri badii koo hawwan hundi
qaanaʼanii duubatti haa deebiʼan.

verses.text: Warri, “Baga! Baga!” anaan jedhan

continuations.text: qaanaʼanii duubatti haa deebiʼan.

verses.text: Warri si barbaadan hundinuu garuu

continuations.text: sitti gammadanii haa ililchan;
warri fayyisuu kee jaallatan,
yeroo hunda, “Waaqni guddaa dha!” haa jedhan.

verses.text: Ani garuu hiyyeessaa fi rakkataa dha;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqi, dafii na qaqqabi.
Ati gargaaraa koo fi fayyisaa koo ti;
yaa Waaqayyo hin turin.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani kooluu sitti galeera;

continuations.text: ati gonkumaa na hin qaanessin.

verses.text: Qajeelummaa keetiin na baasi; na oolchis;

continuations.text: gurra kee gara kootti qabi; na fayyisis.

verses.text: Ati kattaa ani kooluu itti galu,

continuations.text: iddoo ani yeroo hunda itti baqadhu naa taʼi;
ati waan kattaa koo fi daʼoo koo taateef,
na baraaruuf ajaja kenni.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqa ko, harka nama hamaa,

continuations.text: qabaa nama jalʼaatii fi gara jabeessaa keessaa na baasi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, ati abdii kootii;

continuations.text: ijoollummaa kootii kaaftees ati Waaqa ani amanadhuu dha.

verses.text: Ani gaafan dhaladhee jalqabee sitti irkadheera;

continuations.text: gadameessa haadha koo keessaas situ na baase.
Ani yeroo hunda sin galateeffadha.

verses.text: Ani namoota baayʼeedhaaf mallattoo taʼeera;

continuations.text: ati garuu daʼoo koo isa jabaa dha.

verses.text: Afaan koo guyyaa guutuu,

continuations.text: galataa fi ulfina keetiin guutama.

verses.text: Yeroo ani dulloomutti ati na hin gatin;

continuations.text: yeroo humni koo dhumuttis na hin dhiisin.

verses.text: Diinonni koo natti mariʼatuutii;

continuations.text: warri na ajjeesuuf riphanii eeggatanis walii wajjin natti mariʼatu.

verses.text: Isaanis, “Waaqni isa dhiiseera;

continuations.text: namni isa oolchu tokko iyyuu hin jiruutii
faana buʼaatii qabaa” jedhu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, narraa hin fagaatin;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqa ko, na gargaaruuf dafii kottu.

verses.text: Warri na himatan qaanaʼanii haa badan;

continuations.text: warri na miidhuu barbaadanis
tuffii fi salphina haa uffatan.

verses.text: Ani garuu yeroo hundumaa abdii qaba;

continuations.text: ittuma caalchisees sin galateeffadha.

verses.text: Ani yoo hammam akka inni gaʼu beekuu baadhe illee,

continuations.text: afaan koo waaʼee qajeelummaa keetiitii fi
waaʼee fayyisuu keetii guyyaa guutuu ni odeessa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, ani dhufee

continuations.text: hojii kee humna qabeessa sana nan odeessa;
ani qajeelummaa kee qofa labsa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati ijoollummaa kootii jalqabdee na barsiifteerta;

continuations.text: anis hamma harʼaatti hojii kee dinqisiisaa sana nan labsa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, yeroo ani dulloomee mataan koo arrii taʼutti illee,

continuations.text: hamma ani humna kee dhaloota kanatti,
jabina kees dhaloota dhufuuf jiru hundatti labsuutti,
ati na hin dhiisin.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, qajeelummaan kee samiiwwan bira gaʼa;

continuations.text: ati waan gurguddaa hojjetteerta;
yaa Waaqi, kan akka keetii eenyu?

verses.text: Ati rakkinaa fi dhiphina baayʼee na argisiifteerta;

continuations.text: taʼus jireenya koo deebiftee ni haaromsita,
qilee lafaa keessaas deebiftee ol na baafta.

verses.text: Ulfina koo ni guddifta;

continuations.text: amma illee na jajjabeessita.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqa ko, ani amanamummaa keetiif,

continuations.text: kiraaraan sin faarfadha;
Yaa Qulqullicha Israaʼel
ani kiraaraan faarfannaa galataa siif faarfadha.

verses.text: Yommuu ani faarfannaa galataa siif faarfadhutti, hidhiin koo,

continuations.text: lubbuun koo kan ati furtes guddisanii ni ililchu.

verses.text: Warri na miidhuu barbaadan,

continuations.text: waan qaanaʼanii burjaajaʼaniif
arrabni koo guyyaa guutuu
qajeelummaa kee odeessa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, murtii kee mootiidhaaf,

continuations.text: qajeelumma kee immoo ilma mootiitiif kenni.

verses.text: Innis saba keetiif qajeelummaadhaan murteessa;

continuations.text: hiyyeeyyiifis murtii qajeelaa kenna.

verses.text: Tulluuwwan badhaadhummaa,

continuations.text: gaarran immoo ija qajeelummaa sabaaf haa fidan.

verses.text: Inni hiyyeeyyii saba keessa jiraataniif ni falma;

continuations.text: ijoollee rakkattootaa ni oolcha;
cunqursituu immoo ni barbadeessa.

verses.text: Namoonni hamma aduun jiraattuu fi hamma jiʼi jiraatutti,

continuations.text: dhalootaa hamma dhalootaatti si sodaatu.

verses.text: Inni akkuma bokkaa marga haamame irratti roobuu,

continuations.text: akkuma tiifuu lafa jiisuuttis ni dhufa.

verses.text: Bara isaa keessa qajeelummaan ni daraara;

continuations.text: nageenyis hamma jiʼi dhabamutti ni baayʼata.

verses.text: Innis galaanaa hamma galaanaatti,

continuations.text: Laga Efraaxiisii hamma moggaa lafaatti ni bulcha.

verses.text: Warri gammoojjii keessa jiraatan fuula isaa duratti ni sagadu;

continuations.text: diinonni isaas biyyoo arraabu.

verses.text: Mootonni Tarshiishii fi mootonni

continuations.text: biyyoota qarqarawwan galaana fagoo gibira isaaf ni fidu;
mootonni Shebaatii fi mootonni Saabaa kennaa ni fiduuf.

verses.text: Mootonni hundinuus isaaf ni sagadu;

continuations.text: saboonni hundinuus isa ni tajaajilu.

verses.text: Inni nama rakkatee gara isaatti iyyu,

continuations.text: hiyyeessaa fi nama gargaarsa hin qabne ni baraaraatii.

verses.text: Nama dadhabaa fi rakkataaf garaa lafa;

continuations.text: nama rakkataas duʼa jalaa baasa.

verses.text: Lubbuu isaaniis hacuuccaa fi cunqursaa jalaa ni fura;

continuations.text: dhiigni isaanii fuula isaa duratti gatii guddaa qabaatii.

verses.text: Umuriin isaa haa dheeratu;

continuations.text: warqeen Shebaa isaaf haa kennamu.
Yeroo hunda Waaqa isaaf haa kadhatan;
guyyaa guutuus isa haa eebbisan.

verses.text: Lafa irratti midhaan akka malee haa baayʼatu;

continuations.text: fiixee tulluuwwanii irras asii fi achi haa raafamu.
Iji isaa akka Libaanoon haa tolu;
akka marga lafaas haa misu.

verses.text: Maqaan isaa bara baraan haa jiraatu;

continuations.text: Akkuma aduus itti fufee haa jiraatu.
Saboonni hundinuu isaan ni eebbifamu;
jarris eebbifamaa jedhaanii isa waamu.

verses.text: Inni kophaa isaa waan dinqii hojjetu,

continuations.text: Waaqayyo Waaqni, Waaqni Israaʼel haa eebbifamu.

verses.text: Maqaa isaa ulfaataa sanaaf bara baraan galanni haa taʼu;

continuations.text: lafti hundinuu ulfina isaatiin haa guutamu.
Ameen; Ameen.

verses.text: Kadhannaan Daawit ilma Isseey as irratti xumurame.
Dhugumaan Waaqni Israaʼeliif,

continuations.text: warra garaan isaanii qulqulluu taʼeef gaarii dha.

verses.text: Ani garuu miilli koo gufachuu gaʼee,

continuations.text: faanni koos mucucaachuu gaʼee ture.

verses.text: Ani yommuun badhaadhummaa hamootaa argetti,

continuations.text: of tuultotatti hinaafeen tureetii.

verses.text: Isaan hin dhiphatan;

continuations.text: dhagni isaaniis fayyaa dha; cimaa dhas.

verses.text: Rakkinni nama biraatti dhufu isaanitti hin dhufu;

continuations.text: isaan akka namoota kaanii dhukkubaan hin dhaʼaman.

verses.text: Kanaafuu of tuulummaan faaya morma isaanii ti;

continuations.text: fincilas akka wayyaatti uffatu.

verses.text: Iji isaanii coomee alatti dhiibama;

continuations.text: hamminni isaan garaatti yaadan dhuma hin qabu.

verses.text: Isaan ni qoosu; hamminas ni dubbatu;

continuations.text: of tuulaa cunqursaadhaan nama doorsisu.

verses.text: Afaan isaanii samii falmata;

continuations.text: arrabni isaaniis lafa dhaala.

verses.text: Kanaafuu sabni gara isaaniitti dachaʼee

continuations.text: bishaan baayʼee dhuga.

verses.text: Isaanis, “Waaqni akkamitti beekuu dandaʼaa?

continuations.text: Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii beekumsa qabaa?” jedhu.

verses.text: Egaa namoonni hamoon akkana;

continuations.text: isaan yeroo hunda yaaddoo malee jiraatu;
badhaadhummaanis guddachaa deemu.

verses.text: Yoos ani akkasumaan garaa koo qulqullinaan eeggadhee

continuations.text: harka koos akkasumaan dhiqadhe kaa!

verses.text: Ani guyyaa guutuu dhaʼameera;

continuations.text: ganama ganamas adabameera.

verses.text: Ani utuu, “Akkana nan dubbadha” jedhee jiraadhee

continuations.text: silaa ijoollee kee nan yakkan ture.

verses.text: Garuu yommuu ani waan kana hunda hubachuu yaaletti,

continuations.text: wanni kun hojii dadhabsiisaa natti taʼe.

verses.text: Kunis hamma ani iddoo qulqullummaa Waaqaa seenutti ture;

continuations.text: ergasiis ani galgala isaanii nan hubadhe.

verses.text: Dhugumaan ati iddoo mucucaataa irra isaan dhaabde;

continuations.text: akka isaan kufanii caccabaniifis gad isaan darbatte.

verses.text: Isaan akkamiin guutumaan guutuutti sodaadhaan fudhatamanii

continuations.text: akkuma tasaa barbadaaʼan!

verses.text: Akkuma abjuun yeroo namni hirribaa dammaqutti taʼu sana,

continuations.text: atis yaa Gooftaa, akkasuma yommuu ol kaatu,
hawwii garaa isaanii ni busheessita.

verses.text: Yommuu lubbuun koo gadditee

continuations.text: onneen koos waraanamtetti,

verses.text: ani gowwaa fi wallaalaan ture;

continuations.text: fuula kee durattis akka horii nan taʼe.

verses.text: Taʼus ani yeroo hunda si wajjinan jira;

continuations.text: atis harka koo mirgaa ni qabda.

verses.text: Ati gorsa keetiin na qajeelchita;

continuations.text: ergasii immoo ulfinatti na galchita.

verses.text: Ani samii keessaa eenyunan qaba?

continuations.text: Lafa irraas si malee homaa hin fedhu.

verses.text: Foon koo fi onneen koo dadhabuu dandaʼu;

continuations.text: Waaqni garuu jabina garaa koo ti;
bara baraanis inni qooda koo.

verses.text: Warri sirraa fagoo jiran ni badu;

continuations.text: atis warra siif hin amanamne hunda ni balleessita.

verses.text: Akka ani yaadutti garuu Waaqatti dhiʼaachuun gaarii dha;

continuations.text: Waaqayyo Gooftaa daʼoo koo godhadheera;
ani hojii kee hunda nan labsa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati maaliif bara baraan nu gatte?

continuations.text: Aariin kee maaliif hoolota ati bobbaafte irratti akka malee bobaʼa?

verses.text: Saba ati dur filatte,

continuations.text: gosa dhaala keetii, warra ati furte,
Tulluu Xiyoon iddoo ati jiraattes yaadadhu.

verses.text: Tarkaanfii kee gara waan bara baraan diigameetti qajeelfadhu;

continuations.text: diinni waan mana qulqullummaa keessa jiru hunda barbadeesseera.

verses.text: Diinonni kee iddoo qulqulluu kee keessatti bookkisan;

continuations.text: mallattoo isaaniis mallattoo godhanii dhaabbatan.

verses.text: Isaan nama bosona keessatti muka muruuf

continuations.text: qottoo ol fudhatu fakkaatu.

verses.text: Isaanis waan soofame hunda,

continuations.text: qottoo fi burrusaan caccabsan.

verses.text: Isaan mana qulqullummaa kee guban;

continuations.text: lafa jireenya Maqaa keetiis ni xureessan.

verses.text: Garaa isaanii keessatti, “Nu guutumaan guutuutti // isaan barbadeessina!” jedhan.

continuations.text: Iddoo Waaqni biyyattii keessatti itti waaqeffamaa ture hundumas ni guban.

verses.text: Mallattoon dinqii nuu hin kennamne;

continuations.text: siʼachi raajiin tokko illee hin jiru;
wanni kun hamma yoomiitti akka turu // nu keessaa namni beeku hin jiru.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, hamma yoomiitti diinni sitti qoosa?

continuations.text: Amajaajiinis bara baraan maqaa kee xureessaa?

verses.text: Ati maaliif harka kee, harka kee mirgaa dachaafatta?

continuations.text: Harka kee bobaa jalaa baafadhuutii isaan barbadeessi!

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati durumaa jalqabdee mootii koo ti;

continuations.text: lafa irrattis hojii fayyinaa hojjetta.

verses.text: Situ humna keetiin galaana gargar qoode;

continuations.text: ati bishaan keessattis mataa bineensa jawwee fakkaatuu caccabsite.

verses.text: Situ mataa Lewaataan caccabsee nyaata godhee

continuations.text: uumamawwan gammoojjii jiraataniif kenne.

verses.text: Situ burqaawwanii fi bishaan yaaʼuuf karaa bane;

continuations.text: ati laga yeroo hunda yaaʼu illee gogsiteerta.

verses.text: Guyyaan kan kee ti; halkanis keetuma;

continuations.text: ati aduu fi jiʼa uumteerta.

verses.text: Situ daarii lafaa hunda dhaabe;

continuations.text: ati bonaa fi ganna uumteerta.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkamitti akka diinni sitti qoosu,

continuations.text: akkamitti akka namoonni gowwoonnis maqaa kee xureessan yaadadhu.

verses.text: Lubbuu gugee keetii dabarsitee bineensa bosonaatti hin kennin;

continuations.text: jireenya saba kee hiyyoomee bara baraan hin irraanfatin.

verses.text: Kakuu kee eegi;

continuations.text: iddoon lafaa dukkanaaʼaan hundinuu // gooliidhaan guutameeraatii.

verses.text: Warri cunqurfaman qaanaʼanii duubatti hin deebiʼin;

continuations.text: hiyyeeyyii fi rakkattoonni maqaa kee haa galateeffatan.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi kaʼi; dubbii kees falmadhu;

continuations.text: akka gowwoonni guyyaa guutuu sitti qoosan yaadadhu.

verses.text: Dhaadachuu diinota keetii, bookkisuu diina keetii

continuations.text: kan gargar hin cinne sana hin dagatin.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, nu si galateeffanna;

continuations.text: sababii Maqaan kee dhiʼoo taʼeef galata siif galchina;
namoonni waaʼee dinqii hojii keetii odeessu.

verses.text: Ati akkana jetta; “Ani yeroo murteeffame nan filadha;

continuations.text: kan qajeelummaadhaan muru ana.

verses.text: Yommuu laftii fi sabni ishee hundi raafamanitti,

continuations.text: kan utubaa ishee jabeessee qabu ana.

verses.text: Ani of tuultotaan akkana nan jedha; ‘Of hin jajinaa.’

continuations.text: Hamootaanis, ‘Gaanfa keessan ol hin qabatinaa.

verses.text: Gaanfa keessan samiitti hin kaasinaa;

continuations.text: morma keessan dheereffattanii hin dubbatinaa.’ ”

verses.text: Ulfinni baʼa biiftuutii yookaan lixa biiftuutii

continuations.text: yookaan lafa onaatii hin dhufuutii.

verses.text: Garuu kan murtii kennu Waaqa;

continuations.text: inni nama tokko gad buusa; kaan immoo ol baasa.

verses.text: Harka Waaqayyoo keessa,

continuations.text: xoofoo wayinii urgooftuudhaan walitti makame
kan hoomachaan guutame tokkotu jira;
inni wayinii sana gad naqa;
hamoonni lafaa hundinuu utuu siicoo isaa illee hin hambisin // xuruurfatanii dhugu.

verses.text: Ani garuu bara baraan waan kana nan labsa;

continuations.text: Waaqa Yaaqoobis nan faarfadha.

verses.text: Gaanfa hamoota hundaa nan caccabsa;

continuations.text: gaanfi qajeeltotaa garuu ol ol jedha.

heading: Abbaa Murtii Addunyaa Hundaa
Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Yeedaloo, “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Faarfannaa Asaaf.

verses.text: Yihuudaa keessatti Waaqni beekamaa dha;

continuations.text: maqaan isaas Israaʼel keessatti guddaa dha.

verses.text: Dunkaanni isaa Saalem keessa,

continuations.text: iddoon jireenya isaa Xiyoon keessa jira.

verses.text: Innis achitti xiyya bobaʼuu fi gaachana, goraadee fi

continuations.text: meeshaawwan waraanaa caccabse.

verses.text: Ati ifa uffattee miidhagdeerta;

continuations.text: ati tulluuwwan bara baraa caalaa Surra qabeessa.

verses.text: Gootonni boojiʼamaniiru;

continuations.text: hirribaanis fudhatamaniiru;
duultota keessaas namni tokko iyyuu
harka sochoofachuu hin dandeenye.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqa Yaaqoob, ifannaa keetiin fardeenii

continuations.text: fi warri fardeen yaabbatan of wallaalaniiru.

verses.text: Siʼi qofatu sodaatamuu qaba.

continuations.text: Yommuu ati aartu eenyutu fuula kee dura dhaabachuu dandaʼaa?

verses.text: Ati samii irraa murtii kennite;

continuations.text: laftis ni sodaatte; ni calʼiftes;

verses.text: yaa Waaqi, wanni kunis yommuu ati murtii kennuudhaaf,

continuations.text: rakkattoota biyyattii fayyisuuf kaatetti taʼe.

verses.text: Dheekkamsi ati namatti dheekkamtu dhugumaan ulfina siif fida;

continuations.text: warra dheekkamsa kee irraa hafanis ni hidhatta.

verses.text: Waaqayyo Waaqa keessaniif wareegaa; wareegichas guuttadhaa;

continuations.text: warri naannoo isaa jiraatan hundinuus
Waaqa sodaatamuu qabu sanaaf kennaawwan haa fidan.

verses.text: Inni hafuura bulchitootaa ni cabsa;

continuations.text: mootonni lafaas isa sodaatu.

heading: Faarfannaa Waaqa Sodaatamuu Qabuuf Faarfatame
Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa Ribuutiin. Faarfannaa Asaaf.

verses.text: Ani gargaarsaaf gara Waaqaatti nan iyyadhe;

continuations.text: ani akka Waaqni na dhagaʼuuf nan iyyadhe.

verses.text: Yeroo rakkina kootiitti Gooftaa nan barbaaddadhe;

continuations.text: halkanis utuu hin dadhabin harka koo nan diriirfadhe;
lubbuun koos jajjabaachuu didde.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ani yommuun si yaadadhu nan aada;

continuations.text: ani irra deddeebiʼee nan yaade; hafuurri koos ni laafe.

verses.text: Ati akka iji koo hin dunuunfanne goote;

continuations.text: ani akka malee lubbamee dubbachuu iyyuu dadhabe.

verses.text: Ani waaʼee bara durii,

continuations.text: waaʼee waggoota durii duriis nan yaade;

verses.text: ani halkaniin faarfannaa koo nan yaadadhe.

continuations.text: Ani irra deddeebiʼee na yaade; // hafuurri koos akkana jedhee qorate:

verses.text: “Gooftaan bara baraan nama gataa?

continuations.text: Inni deebiʼee garaa hin laafuu?

verses.text: Araarri isaa bara baraan badee?

continuations.text: Waadaan isaa bara baraan guutamuu dhabee?

verses.text: Waaqni arjoomuu irraanfateeraa?

continuations.text: Inni aariidhaan gara laafina isaa dhiiseeraa?”

verses.text: Anis, “Harki mirgaa kan Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii

continuations.text: jijjiirameera jedhee yaaduun koo, dadhabbii koo ti” nan jedhe.

verses.text: Ani hojii Waaqayyoo nan yaadadha;

continuations.text: dhugumaan dinqii kee kan durii nan yaadadhaa.

verses.text: Ani waan ati hojjette hunda irra deddeebiʼee nan yaada;

continuations.text: waaʼee hojii keetii illee nan dubbadha.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, karaan kee qulqulluu dha.

continuations.text: Waaqni guddaan akka Waaqa keenyaa eessa jira?

verses.text: Ati Waaqa hojii dinqii hojjettuu dha;

continuations.text: saboota gidduuttis humna kee ni argisiifta.

verses.text: Irree kee cimaadhaan saba kee,

continuations.text: sanyii Yaaqoobii fi sanyii Yoosef furteerta.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, bishaanonni si argan;

continuations.text: bishaanonni si arganii sodaatan;
tuujubawwan ni hollatan.

verses.text: Duumessi bishaan gad dhangalaase;

continuations.text: samiiwwan ni qaqawweessaʼan;
xiyyi kees qixa hundaan balaqqise.

verses.text: Bakakkaan kee bubbee hamaa keessaa dhagaʼame;

continuations.text: balaqqeesi kee addunyaa ibse;
laftis hollattee sochoote.

verses.text: Daandiin kee galaana keessa,

continuations.text: karaan kee immoo bishaanota gurguddaa keessa baʼa;
garuu faanni kee hin argamne.

verses.text: Ati harka Museetii fi harka Arooniin,

continuations.text: saba kee akka bushaayeetti geggeessite.

heading: Seenaa Israaʼel Yaaduu
Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Yeduutuuniif. Faarfannaa Asaaf.

verses.text: Yaa saba ko, barsiisa koo dhagaʼaa;

continuations.text: dubbii afaan koo dhaggeeffadhaa.

verses.text: Ani fakkeenyaan afaan koo nan banadha;

continuations.text: waan durumaa jalqabee dhokfames nan dubbadha.

verses.text: Kunis waanuma nu dhageenyee fi waanuma nu beeknu,

continuations.text: waan abbootiin keenya nutti himanii dha.

verses.text: Nus waan kana ijoollee isaanii duraa hin dhoksinu;

continuations.text: hojii Waaqayyoo ulfina qabeessa sana,
humna isaatii fi dinqii inni hojjete,
dhaloota itti aanutti ni himna.

verses.text: Inni Yaaqoobiif sirna dhaabe;

continuations.text: Israaʼeliif immoo seera kenne;
waan kana illee akka isaan // ijoollee isaanii barsiisaniif,
abbootii keenya ajaje;

verses.text: kunis akka dhaloonni itti aanu beeku,

continuations.text: akka ijoolleen amma iyyuu hin dhalatin beekan,
isaanis akka ijoollee isaaniitti dabarsanii himaniif.

verses.text: Yoos isaan Waaqa amanatu;

continuations.text: ajaja isaas ni eegu malee hojii isaa hin irraanfatan.

verses.text: Isaan akka abbootii isaanii,

continuations.text: akka dhaloota mata jabeessaa fi fincilaa,
warra garaan isaanii Waaqaaf hin ajajamnee,
akka warra hafuurri isaanii isaaf hin amanamin sanaa hin taʼan.

verses.text: Namoonni Efreem xiyya qabatanii turan;

continuations.text: taʼus gaafa lolaa duubatti deebiʼan.

verses.text: Isaan kakuu Waaqaa hin eegne;

continuations.text: seera isaattis buluu didan.

verses.text: Isaan hojii inni hojjete,

continuations.text: dinqii inni isaanitti argisiises ni irraanfatan.

verses.text: Inni fuula abbootii isaanii duratti,

continuations.text: biyya Gibxi kutaa Zooʼaanitti waan nama dinqisiisu hojjete.

verses.text: Inni galaana gargar qoodee gidduun isaan dabarse;

continuations.text: bishaan sanas akkuma keenyan manaa dhaabachiise.

verses.text: Guyyaa duumessaan, halkan guutuu immoo

continuations.text: ifa ibiddaatiin isaan geggeesse.

verses.text: Inni gammoojjii keessatti kattaa dayyaasee

continuations.text: bishaan akka galaanaa baayʼatu isaanii kenne.

verses.text: Kattaa keessaa burqaa burqisiisee

continuations.text: akka bishaan akkuma lagaatti yaaʼu godhe.

verses.text: Isaan garuu gammoojjii keessatti Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitti fincilan;

continuations.text: ittuma fufaniis isatti cubbuu hojjetan.

verses.text: Isaan nyaata dharraʼanii, “Fidi” jechuudhaan

continuations.text: beekumsa Waaqaa qoran.

verses.text: Akkana jedhanii Waaqa hamatan;

continuations.text: “Waaqni gammoojjii keessatti maaddii qopheessuu dandaʼaa?

verses.text: Inni kattaa rukunnaan bishaan humnaan keessaa burqe;

continuations.text: burqaan guutee irraan dhangalaʼe.
Garuu inni nyaata nuu kennuu dandaʼaa?
Saba isaatiifis foon kennuu dandaʼaa?”

verses.text: Waaqayyo yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti baayʼee aare;

continuations.text: Yaaqoob irratti ibiddi isaa ni qabsiifame;
dheekkamsi isaas Israaʼelitti dhufe;

verses.text: isaan Waaqa hin amananneetii;

continuations.text: fayyisuu isaattis hin amanne.

verses.text: Inni garuu samii gubbaatiif ajaja kenne;

continuations.text: balbala samiis ni bane;

verses.text: akka isaan nyaataniif mannaa gad roobseef;

continuations.text: midhaan samiis isaaniif kenne.

verses.text: Namoonni buddeena ergamoota Waaqayyoo nyaatan;

continuations.text: inni waan isaan nyaatanii quufan ergeef.

verses.text: Inni akka bubbeen baʼa biiftuu samii keessaa bubbisu godhe;

continuations.text: bubbee kibbaas humna ofii isaatiin oofe.

verses.text: Foon akkuma awwaaraatti, simbirroota barrisanis

continuations.text: akkuma cirracha galaanaatti gad isaaniif roobse.

verses.text: Innis akka isaan qubata isaanii keessatti

continuations.text: naannoo dunkaanota isaaniitti gad harcaʼan godhe.

verses.text: Isaanis nyaatanii quufan;

continuations.text: inni waan isaan dharraʼan isaaniif kenneeraatii.

verses.text: Garuu utuu isaan nyaata dharraʼan sana hin quufin,

continuations.text: utuma nyaanni sun afaan isaanii keessa jiruu,

verses.text: dheekkamsi Waaqaa isaanitti dhufe;

continuations.text: innis isaan keessaa warra jajjabeeyyii galaafate;
dargaggeeyyii Israaʼelis ni fixe.

verses.text: Isaan waan kana hunda irra darbanii cubbuu hojjechuutti fufan;

continuations.text: dinqii isaattis hin amanne.

verses.text: Kanaafuu inni akka barri isaanii faayidaa malee darbu,

continuations.text: akka waggoonni isaaniis sodaadhaan dhuman godhe.

verses.text: Yeroo Waaqni isaan ajjeese kamitti iyyuu, // isaan isa barbaaddatan;

continuations.text: isaan ammas fedhiidhaan gara isaatti deebiʼan.

verses.text: Akka Waaqni Kattaa isaanii taʼe,

continuations.text: akka Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii Furii isaanii taʼe yaadatan.

verses.text: Isaan garuu afaan isaaniitiin isa saadan;

continuations.text: arraba isaaniitiinis isa soban;

verses.text: garaan isaanii isaaf amanamaa hin turre;

continuations.text: isaan kakuu isaatiif hin amanamne.

verses.text: Inni garuu araara qabeessa waan taʼeef,

continuations.text: cubbuu isaanii ni dhiiseef malee isaan hin fixne.
Inni yeroo yerootti aarii isaa ittifate;
dheekkamsa isaa hundaas hin kakaafne.

verses.text: Innis akka isaan nama duʼa hin oolle,

continuations.text: qilleensuma darbu kan deebiʼee hin dhufne taʼan yaadate.

verses.text: Isaan hammam gammoojjii keessatti isatti fincilanii

continuations.text: gammoojjii keessattis isa gaddisiisan

verses.text: Isaan ammumaa amma Waaqa qoran;

continuations.text: Qulqullicha Israaʼel sanas ni aarsan.

verses.text: Isaan humna isaa yookaan guyyaa inni itti

continuations.text: diinota isaanii jalaa isaan baase hin yaadanne.

verses.text: Guyyaa inni itti biyya Gibxi keessatti mallattoo isaa,

continuations.text: kutaa Zooʼaan keessatti immoo dinqii isaa argisiise isaan hin yaadanne.

verses.text: Inni lageen isaanii dhiigatti geeddare;

continuations.text: isaanis burqaawwan isaanii dhuguu hin dandeenye.

verses.text: Innis tuuta tisiisaa kan isaan balleessu,

continuations.text: fattee isaan barbadeessu itti erge.

verses.text: Midhaan isaanii ilmaan hawwaannisaatiif,

continuations.text: buʼaa dadhabbii isaanii immoo hawwaannisaaf kenne.

verses.text: Muka wayinii isaanii cabbiidhaan,

continuations.text: harbuu isaanii immoo dhaamocha hamaan dhaʼe.

verses.text: Loon isaanii cabbiif,

continuations.text: horii isaanii immoo bakakkaaf dabarsee kenne.

verses.text: Inni ergamoota badiisa fidan isaanitti erguudhaan

continuations.text: aarii isaa sodaachisaa, dheekkamsa isaa,
dallansuu isaatii fi rakkoo isaanitti gad lakkise.

verses.text: Inni aarii isaatiif daandii qopheesse;

continuations.text: lubbuu isaanii dabarsee dhaʼichatti kenne malee
duʼa isaan hin oolchine.

verses.text: Hangafoota Gibxi hunda,

continuations.text: ilmaan jalqabatti dhalatanis dunkaana Haam keessatti dhaʼe.

verses.text: Saba isaa garuu akkuma nama bushaayee bobbaasuutti achii baase;

continuations.text: akkuma hoolaas gammoojjii keessa isaan geggeesse.

verses.text: Inni nagaadhaan isaan geggeesse; // kanaafuu isaan homaa hin sodaanne;

continuations.text: diinota isaanii garuu galaanatu liqimse.

verses.text: Innis gara daarii biyya isaa qulqulluutti,

continuations.text: gara biyya gaaraa kan harki isaa mirgaa fudhateetti isaan galche.

verses.text: Inni ormoota isaan duraa ariʼe;

continuations.text: lafa jaraas dhaala godhee isaanii qoode;
gosa Israaʼelis dunkaana isaanii keessa qubachiise.

verses.text: Isaan garuu Waaqa qoran;

continuations.text: Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitti fincilan;
ajaja isaas hin eegne.
