Waaqa Rakkina Hunda Keessaa Nama Baasu

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, garaan koo hin raafamu; ani nan faarfadha;

continuations.text: lubbuu koo guutuudhaanis sin galateeffadha.

verses.text: Yaa kiraaraa fi baganaa dammaqaa!

continuations.text: Anis ganamaan nan dammaqa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani saboota gidduutti galata siif nan galcha;

continuations.text: namoota gidduuttis waaʼee kee nan faarfadha.

verses.text: Jaalalli kee guddaa dha; samiiwwanis caalaa ol dheeraadhaatii;

continuations.text: amanamummaan kees samiiwwan qaqqaba.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ati samiiwwaniin olitti ol ol jedhi;

continuations.text: ulfinni kees lafa hunda irra haa jiraatu.

verses.text: Akka warri ati jaallattu furamaniif,

continuations.text: harka kee mirgaatiin nu oolchi; nu gargaaris;

verses.text: Waaqni iddoo qulqullummaa isaatii akkana jedhee dubbateera:

continuations.text: “Ani gammachuudhaan Sheekemin gargar nan qooda;
Sulula Sukootis nan safara.

verses.text: Giliʼaad kan koo ti; Minaaseenis kan koo ti;

continuations.text: Efreem gonfoo sibiilaa koo ti;
Yihuudaanis bokkuu mootummaa koo ti.

verses.text: Moʼaab caabii dhiqannaa koo ti;

continuations.text: Edoom irra kophee koo darbadhee nan buusa;
Filisxeem irrattis moʼannaadhaan nan geerara.”

verses.text: Eenyutu magaalaa jabeeffamtee ijaaramtetti na fida?

continuations.text: Eenyutu Edoomitti na geessa?

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi kan nu gatte,

continuations.text: kan loltoota keenya wajjin baʼuu diddes suma mitii?

verses.text: Diina keenya of irraa dhowwuu nu gargaar,

continuations.text: gargaarsi namaa faayidaa hin qabuutii.

verses.text: Nu Waaqa wajjin ni moʼanna;

continuations.text: innis diinota keenya gad dhidhiita.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqa ani galateeffadhu

continuations.text: ati hin calʼisin;

verses.text: namoonni hamoonnii fi gowwoomsitoonni,

continuations.text: afaan isaanii natti banatanii jiruutii;
isaan arraba sobaatiin maqaa na balleessaniiru.

verses.text: Isaan dubbii jibbaatiin na marsan;

continuations.text: sababii tokko malees na lolan.

verses.text: Utuma ani isaan jaalladhuu na himatan;

continuations.text: ani garuu nan kadhadha.

verses.text: Qooda waan gaarii hammina,

continuations.text: qooda jaalala koo immoo jibba naa deebisan.

verses.text: Akka inni isa mormuuf nama itti ramadi;

continuations.text: seexannis karaa mirga isaa haa dhaabatu.

verses.text: Yommuu qoratamutti isatti haa muramu;

continuations.text: kadhannaan isaas cubbuu isatti haa taʼu.

verses.text: Umuriin isaa haa gabaabbatu,

continuations.text: aangoo isaa namni biraa haa fudhatu.

verses.text: Ijoolleen isaa abbaa malee haa hafan;

continuations.text: niitiin isaas haadha hiyyeessaa haa taatu.

verses.text: Ijoolleen isaa kadhattoota asii fi achi jooran haa taʼan;

continuations.text: mana isaanii diigamaa keessaa illee haa ariʼaman.

verses.text: Waan inni qabu hunda namni isa irraa liqii qabu haa fudhatu;

continuations.text: buʼaa dadhabbii isaa illee karaa adeemtonni haa saaman.

verses.text: Namni tokko iyyuu isaaf hin naʼin,

continuations.text: yookaan ijoollee isaa kanneen abbaa hin qabneef garaa hin laafin.

verses.text: Sanyiin isaa haa dhumu;

continuations.text: maqaan isaanii dhaloota itti aanu keessaa haa balleeffamu.

verses.text: Balleessaan abbootii isaa fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa yaadatamu;

continuations.text: cubbuun haadha isaas hin haqamin.

verses.text: Akka inni seenaa isaanii lafa irraa balleessuuf,

continuations.text: cubbuun isaanii yeroo hunda fuula Waaqayyoo dura haa jiraatu.

verses.text: Inni hiyyeeyyii fi rakkattoota,

continuations.text: warra garaan isaanii madaaʼes hamma duʼaatti gugse malee
garaa isaaniif laafuu hin yaadneetii.

verses.text: Inni abaaruu jaallate;

continuations.text: abaarsi sun isumatti haa deebiʼu;
inni eebbisuu hin jaallanne;
eebbis isa irraa haa fagaatu.

verses.text: Inni akkuma uffata isaatti abaarsa uffata;

continuations.text: abaarsis akkuma bishaanii dhagna isaa seena;
akkuma zayitiis lafee isaa lixa.

verses.text: Abaarsi sun akkuma uffata inni ittiin of haguuguu,

continuations.text: sabbata inni yeroo hunda hidhatuus isatti haa taʼu.

verses.text: Kaffaltiin Waaqayyo warra na himatanii fi

continuations.text: warra jireenya koo irratti waan hamaa dubbataniif kaffalu kanuma haa taʼu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa,

continuations.text: ati garuu maqaa keetiif jedhii na gargaar;
gaarummaa jaalala keetiitiif jedhiitii na oolchi.

verses.text: Ani hiyyeessaa fi rakkataadhaatii;

continuations.text: garaan koos na keessatti madaaʼeera.

verses.text: Ani akkuma gaaddidduu galgalaa badeera;

continuations.text: akkuma hawwaannisaas olii gad oofameera.

verses.text: Jilbi koo soomuudhaan dadhabeera;

continuations.text: dhagni koos huqqatee lafeetti baʼeera.

verses.text: Ani warra na himatan biratti waan tuffii taʼeera;

continuations.text: isaan yommuu na argan mataa isaanii raasu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, na gargaari;

continuations.text: akkuma jaalala keetiittis na oolchi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka wanni kun harka kee taʼe,

continuations.text: akka ati waan kana hojjette isaan haa beekan.

verses.text: Isaan ni abaaru; ati garuu ni eebbifta;

continuations.text: yommuu natti kaʼan isaan ni qaanaʼu;
tajaajilaan kee garuu ni gammada.

verses.text: Himattoonni koo salphina haa uffatan;

continuations.text: akkuma nama waaroo uffatuutti qaaniidhaan haa haguugaman.

verses.text: Ani afaan kootiin guddisee Waaqayyoon nan galateeffadha;

continuations.text: waldaa guddaa gidduuttis isa nan jajadha.

verses.text: Innis warra lubbuu isaatti muran jalaa isa baasuuf jedhee,

continuations.text: karaa harka mirga rakkataatiin dhaabataatii.

verses.text: Waaqayyo, gooftaa kootiin:

continuations.text: “Hamma ani diinota kee ejjeta miilla keetii godhutti,
karaa mirga koo taaʼi” jedhe.

verses.text: Waaqayyo, “Diinota kee gidduutti moʼi” jedhee

continuations.text: bokkuu aangoo keetii Xiyoonii siif erga.

verses.text: Gaafa ati waraanaaf baatu,

continuations.text: loltoonni kee fedhee isaaniitiin si faana qajeelu.
Ati gadameessa ganamaa keessaa,
surraa qulqulluu gonfattee fixeensa dargaggummaa keetii qabaatta.

verses.text: Waaqayyo, “Akka sirna Malkiiseedeqitti,

continuations.text: ati luba bara baraa ti” jedhee kakateera.
Inni yaada isaa hin geeddaru.

verses.text: Gooftaan karaa harka kee mirgaa jira;

continuations.text: inni guyyaa dheekkamsa isaatti mootota ni burkuteessa.

verses.text: Inni reeffa tuuluudhaan, bulchitoota guutummaa lafaa

continuations.text: barbadeessuudhaan sabootatti mura.

verses.text: Innis laga karaa cina jiru keessaa ni dhuga;

continuations.text: kanaafuu mataa ol qabata.

heading: Waaqayyo Mootiidhaaf Ol aantummaa Kennuu Isaa
Faarfannaa Daawit.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Ani waldaa tolootaatii fi wal gaʼii keessatti,
garaa koo guutuudhaan Waaqayyoon nan galateeffadha.

verses.text: Hojiin Waaqayyoo guddaa dha;

continuations.text: warri itti gammadan hundinuus irra deddeebiʼanii yaadan.

verses.text: Hojiin isaa surra qabeessaa fi kabajamaa dha;

continuations.text: qajeelummaan isaas bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Inni akka dinqiin isaa yaadatamu godheera;

continuations.text: Waaqayyo arjaa fi gara laafessa.

verses.text: Inni warra isa sodaataniif nyaata kenna;

continuations.text: kakuu isaas bara baraan ni yaadata.

verses.text: Lafa saboota kaanii isaaniif

continuations.text: kennuudhaan humna hojii isaa saba isaatti mulʼiseera.

verses.text: Hojiin harka isaa amanamaa fi qajeelaa dha;

continuations.text: ajajni isaa hundinuus amanamaa dha.

verses.text: Isaanis bara baraa hamma bara baraatti jabaatanii dhaabatu;

continuations.text: amanamummaa fi qajeelummaadhaanis hojjetamu.

verses.text: Inni saba isaatiif furii ergeera;

continuations.text: kakuu isaas bara baraan ajajeera;
maqaan isaa qulqulluu fi sodaachisaa dha.

verses.text: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun jalqaba ogummaa ti;

continuations.text: warri sirna isaa faana buʼan hundinuu hubannaa gaarii qabu.
Galanni isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Namni Waaqayyoon sodaatu,
kan ajaja isaatti baayʼee gammadu eebbifamaa dha.

verses.text: Sanyiin isaa lafa irratti jabaa taʼa;

continuations.text: dhaloonni tolootaa ni eebbifama.

verses.text: Qabeenyii fi badhaadhummaan mana isaa keessa jira;

continuations.text: qajeelummaan isaas bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Nama tolaa fi arjaadhaaf,

continuations.text: gara laafessaa fi qajeelaaf, // dukkana keessatti iyyuu ifni ni baʼa.

verses.text: Nama arjaa fi nama waa namaa liqeessuuf,

continuations.text: nama hojii isaa qajeelummaadhaan adeemsifatuuf // waan gaariitu taʼa.

verses.text: Dhugumaan inni gonkumaa hin raafamu;

continuations.text: namni qajeelaan bara baraan yaadatama.

verses.text: Inni oduu hamaa hin sodaatu;

continuations.text: garaan isaas Waaqayyoon amanachuudhaan // jabaatee dhaabata.

verses.text: Garaan isaa hin raafamu; hin sodaatus;

continuations.text: dhuma irrattis diinota isaa moʼata.

verses.text: Inni ni bittinneesse; hiyyeeyyiifis ni kenne;

continuations.text: qajeelummaan isaa bara baraan ni jiraata;
gaanfi isaas ulfinaan ol qabama.

verses.text: Namni hamaan waan kana argee aara;

continuations.text: ilkaan isaa qara; baqees ni bada;
hawwiin hamootaa faayidaa malee hafa.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Yaa tajaajiltoota Waaqayyoo, galata galchaa;
maqaa Waaqayyoo jajadhaa.

verses.text: Ammaa hamma bara baraatti

continuations.text: maqaan Waaqayyoo haa eebbifamu.

verses.text: Baʼa biiftuutii hamma lixa biiftuutti,

continuations.text: maqaan Waaqayyoo haa jajamu.

verses.text: Waaqayyo saba hundaa ol jira;

continuations.text: ulfinni isaas samiiwwanii ol.

verses.text: Kan akka Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya

continuations.text: isa gubbaa teessoo isaa irra taaʼu sanaa eenyu?

verses.text: Kan gad jedhee

continuations.text: samii fi lafa ilaalu eenyu?

verses.text: Inni hiyyeessa awwaara keessaa ni kaasa;

continuations.text: rakkataas tuulaa daaraa keessaa ol fuudha;

verses.text: inni bulchitoota gidduu,

continuations.text: bulchitoota saba isaa gidduus isaan teessisa.

verses.text: Inni akkuma haadha ijoollee kan gammachuudhaan jiraattuutti,

continuations.text: dubartii maseena mana ishee keessa ni jiraachisa.
Haalleluuyaa.

verses.text: Yeroo sabni Israaʼel biyya Gibxii, manni Yaaqoobis

continuations.text: saba afaan ormaa dubbatu keessaa baʼetti,

verses.text: Yihuudaan mana qulqullummaa Waaqaa,

continuations.text: Israaʼel immoo bulchiinsa isaa taʼe.

verses.text: Galaanni argee baqate;

continuations.text: Yordaanosis duubatti deebiʼe;

verses.text: tulluuwwan akka korbeeyyii hoolaa,

continuations.text: gaarranis akkuma xobbaallaawwan hoolaa burraaqan.

verses.text: Yaa galaana, ati maaliif baqatte?

continuations.text: Yaa Yordaanos, atis maaliif duubatti deebite?

verses.text: Yaa tulluuwwan, isin maaliif akka korbeeyyii hoolaa,

continuations.text: yaa gaarran isinis maaliif akka xobbaallaawwan hoolaa burraaqxu?

verses.text: Yaa lafa, fuula Gooftaa duratti,

continuations.text: fuula Waaqa Yaaqoob duratti holladhu;

verses.text: inni kattaa gara harootti,

continuations.text: kattaa jabaa immoo gara burqaa bishaaniitti geeddare.

verses.text: Nuuf miti; yaa Waaqayyo, nuuf miti;

continuations.text: garuu jaalalaa fi amanamummaa keetiif jedhiitii
maqaa keetiif ulfina kenni.

verses.text: Saboonni maaliif,

continuations.text: “Waaqni isaanii eessa jira?” jedhu?

verses.text: Waaqni keenya samii keessa jira;

continuations.text: inni waan isa gammachiisu kam iyyuu ni hojjeta.

verses.text: Waaqonni isaanii tolfamoon garuu meetii fi

continuations.text: warqee harka namaatiin hojjetamanii dha.

verses.text: Isaan afaan qabu; garuu dubbachuu hin dandaʼan;

continuations.text: ijas qabu; garuu arguu hin dandaʼan;

verses.text: gurra qabu; garuu dhagaʼuu hin dandaʼan;

continuations.text: funyaan qabu; garuu fuunfachuu hin dandaʼan;

verses.text: harka qabu; garuu qaqqabachuu hin dandaʼan;

continuations.text: miilla qabu; garuu deemuu hin dandaʼan;
laagaa isaanii keessattis sagalee tokko illee hin uuman.

verses.text: Warri isaan tolchan

continuations.text: kanneen isaan amanatan hundi akkuma isaanii taʼu.

verses.text: Yaa mana Israaʼel, Waaqayyoon amanadhu;

continuations.text: inni gargaarsaa fi gaachana isaanii ti.

verses.text: Yaa mana Aroon, Waaqayyoon amanadhu;

continuations.text: inni gargaarsaa fi gaachana isaanii ti.

verses.text: Isin warri isa sodaattan, Waaqayyoon amanadhaa;

continuations.text: inni gargaarsaa fi gaachana isaanii ti.

verses.text: Waaqayyo nu yaadata; nu eebbisas;

continuations.text: inni mana Israaʼel ni eebbisa;
mana Aroonis ni eebbisa;

verses.text: inni warra Waaqayyoon sodaatan,

continuations.text: xinnaas guddaas ni eebbisa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo, isinii fi

continuations.text: ijoollee keessan haa baayʼisu.

ב Beet

verses.text: Dargaggeessi akkamitti jireenya qulqulluu jiraachuu dandaʼa?

continuations.text: Akka dubbii keetiitti jiraachuudhaan.

verses.text: Ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin barbaada;

continuations.text: akka ani ajajawwan kee irraa jalʼadhu na hin godhin.

verses.text: Ani akkan cubbuu sitti hin hojjenneef,

continuations.text: dubbii kee garaa koo keessa dhokfadheera.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, galanni siif haa taʼu;

continuations.text: sirna kee na barsiisi.

verses.text: Ani seera afaan keetii baʼu hundumaa,

continuations.text: afaan kootiin nan dubbadha.

verses.text: Akkuma namni tokko badhaadhummaa guddaatti gammadu,

verses.text: Ajajawwan kee irra deddeebiʼee nan yaada;

continuations.text: karaa kee irraas ija koo hin buqqifadhu.

verses.text: Ani sirna keetti nan gammada;

ג Giimeel

verses.text: Akka ani jiraadhuu fi dubbii kee eeguuf,

continuations.text: garbicha keetiif waan gaarii godhi.

verses.text: Akka ani seera kee keessatti

continuations.text: waan dinqisiisaa arguuf, ija koo naa bani.

verses.text: Ani lafa irratti keessummaa dha;

continuations.text: ajajawwan kee na duraa hin dhoksin.

verses.text: Lubbuun koo yeroo hunda

continuations.text: seera kee hawwuudhaan, laafaa jirti.

verses.text: Ati of tuultota warra abaaramoo,

continuations.text: kanneen ajajawwan kee irraa jalʼatan ni ifatta.

verses.text: Waan ani seera kee eeguuf,

continuations.text: arrabsoo fi tuffii isaanii narraa fageessi.

verses.text: Ajajni kee gammachuu koo ti;

ד Daalet

verses.text: Lubbuun koo biyyootti maxxante;

verses.text: Seerri kee dhaala koo kan bara baraa ti;

verses.text: Garaan koo hamma dhumaatti

continuations.text: ajaja kee eeguuf kutateera.
ס Saamek

verses.text: Ani nama yaada lamaa nan jibba;

continuations.text: seera kee garuu nan jaalladha.

verses.text: Ati iddoo ani itti baqadhuu fi gaachana koo ti;

continuations.text: ani dubbii kee abdadheera.

verses.text: Akka ani ajajawwan Waaqa koo eeguuf,

continuations.text: isin warri waan hamaa hojjettan narraa fagaadhaa!

verses.text: Ati akkuma waadaa keetiitti na deeggari; // anis nan jiraadha;

continuations.text: akka ani abdii kootti qaanaʼu na hin godhin.

verses.text: Akka ani nagaadhaan jiraadhuuf na deeggari;

continuations.text: yeroo hunda seera kee nan kabaja.

verses.text: Sababii gowwoomsaan isaanii faayidaa hin qabneef;

continuations.text: ati warra seera kee irraa jalʼatan hunda tuffattee gatta.

verses.text: Ati hamoota lafa irraa hunda akka kosiitti gatta;

continuations.text: kanaafuu ani seera kee nan jaalladha.

verses.text: Foon koo si sodaachuudhaan hollata;

continuations.text: anis murtii kee nan sodaadha.
ע Aayin

verses.text: Ani waan qajeelaa fi tolaa hojjedheera;

continuations.text: ati warra na hacuucanitti dabarsitee na hin kennin.

verses.text: Nagaan jiraachuu tajaajilaa keetii mirkaneessi;

continuations.text: akka of tuultonni na cunqursanis hin eeyyamin.

verses.text: Iji koo fayyisuu kee eeguudhaan,

continuations.text: waadaa kee qajeelaas eeguudhaanis dadhabeera.

verses.text: Akkuma jaalala keetiitti tajaajilaa kee yaadadhu;

continuations.text: seera kees na barsiisi.

verses.text: Ani tajaajilaa kee ti;

continuations.text: akka ani ajaja kee beekuuf hubannaa naa kenni.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, kun yeroo ati itti hojjettuu dha;

continuations.text: seerri kee cabsamaa jiraatii.

verses.text: Kanaafuu ani warqee caalaa,

continuations.text: warqee qulqulluu caalaa, ajajawwan kee nan jaalladha;

verses.text: ani akka seerri kee hundi qajeelaa taʼe nan amana;

continuations.text: daandii sobaa hundas nan jibba.
פ Pee

verses.text: Sirni kee dinqisiisaa dha;

continuations.text: kanaafuu ani isa nan eega.

verses.text: Ibsamuun dubbii keetii ifa kenna;

continuations.text: wallaalotaafis hubannaa kenna.

verses.text: Ani ajajawwan kee hawwuudhaan

continuations.text: afaan koo banee nan hargana.

verses.text: Ati akkuma yeroo hunda warra maqaa kee jaalataniif gootu sana,

continuations.text: gara kootti garagalii na maari.

verses.text: Akkuma dubbii keetiitti tarkaanfii miilla kootii naa qajeelchi;

continuations.text: cubbuun tokko iyyuu narratti hin moʼin.

verses.text: Akka ani ajaja kee eeguuf

continuations.text: hacuuccaa namootaa jalaa na furi.

verses.text: Akka fuulli kee tajaajilaa kee irratti ifu godhi;

continuations.text: sirna kees na barsiisi.

verses.text: Sababii namoonni seerra kee hin eegneef,

continuations.text: iji koo imimmaan lolaasa.
צ Tsaade

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati qajeelaa dha;

continuations.text: murtiin kees qajeelaa dha.

verses.text: Seerri ati kennite qajeelaa dha;

continuations.text: guutummaattis amanamaa dha.

verses.text: Sababii diinonni koo dubbii kee dagataniif,

continuations.text: hinaaffaan ani qabu na guggubeera.

verses.text: Waadaan kee sirriitti qoramee ilaalameera;

continuations.text: tajaajilaan kees isa jaallata.

verses.text: Xinnaadhee tuffatamu iyyuu,

continuations.text: ani ajaja kee hin irraanfadhu.

verses.text: Qajeelummaan kee bara baraan jiraata;

continuations.text: seerri kees dhugaa dha.

verses.text: Rakkinnii fi dhiphinni natti dhufeera;

continuations.text: ajajawwan kee garuu gammachuu koo ti.

verses.text: Seerri kee bara baraan qajeelaa dha;

continuations.text: akka ani jiraadhuuf hubannaa naa kenni.
ק Qoof

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin waammadha;

continuations.text: deebii naa kenni; anis sirna keetiif nan ajajama.

verses.text: Ani sittin iyyadha; ati na fayyisi;

continuations.text: seera kees nan eega.

verses.text: Ani utuu lafti hin bariʼin kaʼee gargaarsaaf nan iyyadha;

continuations.text: ani dubbii kee abdadheera.

verses.text: Akka ani irra deddeebiʼee waadaa kee yaaduuf,

continuations.text: iji koo halkan guutuu banamee bula.

verses.text: Akkuma jaalala keetiitti sagalee koo dhagaʼi;

continuations.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma seera keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.

verses.text: Warri daba mariʼatan as dhiʼoo jiru;

continuations.text: seera kee irraa garuu fagoo jiru.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu dhiʼoo jirta;

continuations.text: ajajawwan kee hundis dhugaa dha.

verses.text: Akka ati ajajawwan kee bara baraan hundeessite,

continuations.text: ani seera kee irraa dur baradheera.
ר Reesh

verses.text: Dhiphina koo argiitii na oolchi;

continuations.text: ani seera kee hin daganneetii.

verses.text: Dubbii koo naa falmi; na furis;

continuations.text: akkuma waadaa keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.

verses.text: Sababii isaan sirna kee hin barbaanneef,

continuations.text: fayyinni hamoota irraa fagaateera.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, gara laafinni kee guddaa dha;

continuations.text: akkuma seera keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.

verses.text: Diinonni koo warri na ariʼatan baayʼee dha;

continuations.text: ani garuu seera kee irraa hin jalʼanne.

verses.text: Sababii isaan dubbii keetiif hin ajajamneef,

continuations.text: ani warra amantii hin qabne ija jibbaatiin nan ilaala.

verses.text: Akkam akka ani qajeelfama kee jaalladhu mee ilaali;

continuations.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma jaalala keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.

verses.text: Dubbiin kee hundinuu dhugaa dha;

continuations.text: seerri kee qajeelaan hundinuus bara baraan jiraata.
ש Siinii fi Shiin

verses.text: Bulchitoonni sababii malee na ariʼatan;

continuations.text: garaan koo garuu dubbii kee // sodaachuudhaan hollata.

verses.text: Ani akka nama boojuu guddaa argate tokkootti,

continuations.text: dubbii keetti nan gammada.

verses.text: Ani soba nan jibba; nan xireeffadhas;

continuations.text: seera kee garuu nan jaalladha.

verses.text: Sababii seera kee qajeelaa sanaatiif,

continuations.text: ani guyyaatti yeroo torba sin galateeffadha.

verses.text: Warri seera kee jaallatan nagaa guddaa qabu;

continuations.text: wanni isaan gufachiisu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani fayyisuu kee nan abdadha;

continuations.text: ajaja kee duukaas nan buʼa.

verses.text: Ani waanan guddaa isa jaalladhuuf,

continuations.text: ajaja kee nan eega.

verses.text: Ati karaa koo hunda waan beektuuf,

continuations.text: ani sirna keetii fi seera kee nan eega.
ת Taaw

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, iyyi koo fuula kee dura haa gaʼu;

continuations.text: ati akkuma dubbii keetiitti hubannaa naa kenni.

verses.text: Waammanni koo fuula kee dura haa gaʼu;

continuations.text: akkuma waadaa keetiitti na baasi.

verses.text: Sababii ati qajeelfama kee na barsiiftuuf,

continuations.text: hidhiin koo galata haa dhangalaasu.

verses.text: Arrabni koo dubbii kee haa faarfatu;

continuations.text: ajajni kee hundi qajeelaadhaatii.

verses.text: Waan ani sirna kee filadheef,

continuations.text: harki kee na gargaaruuf haa qophaaʼu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani fayyisuu kee nan hawwa;

continuations.text: seerri kees gammachuu koo ti.

verses.text: Lubbuun koo si galateeffachuuf haa jiraattu;

continuations.text: seerri kees na haa gargaaru.

verses.text: Ani akkuma hoolaa badee karaa irraa jalʼadheera.

continuations.text: Ani ajajawwan kee hin irraanfanneetii,
tajaajilaa kee barbaadi.

verses.text: Ani rakkina koo keessatti Waaqayyotti nan iyyadha;

continuations.text: innis deebii naa kenna.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, afaan sobuu fi

continuations.text: arraba nama gowwoomsu jalaa na baasi.

verses.text: Yaa arraba gowwoomsituu nana, maaltu siif kennama?

continuations.text: Kana caalaas maal godhamta?

verses.text: Inni xiyya loltootaa kan qarameen,

continuations.text: barbadaa ibiddaa qacamaatiin si adaba.

verses.text: Ani waanan Meshek keessa taaʼee

continuations.text: dunkaanota Qeedaar gidduu jiraadhuuf, anaaf wayyoo!

verses.text: Warra nagaa jibban gidduu,

continuations.text: ani yeroo dheeraa jiraadheera.

verses.text: Ani nama nagaa barbaadu dha;

continuations.text: isaan garuu yeroo ani dubbadhu lolaaf kakaʼan.

verses.text: Ani ija koo gara tulluuwwaniitti ol nan qabadha;

continuations.text: gargaarsi koo eessaa dhufa?

verses.text: Gargaarsi koo Waaqayyo

continuations.text: samii fi lafa uume biraa dhufa.

verses.text: Inni akka miilli kee mucucaatu hin godhu;

continuations.text: kan si eegu hin mugu;

verses.text: dhugumaan inni Israaʼelin eegu

continuations.text: hin mugu; hin rafus.

verses.text: Waaqayyo si eega;

continuations.text: Waaqayyo karaa mirga keetiitiin gaaddisa siif taʼa;

verses.text: guyyaa aduun si hin gubu;

continuations.text: halkanis jiʼi si hin miidhu.

verses.text: Waaqayyo miidhaa hunda irraa si eega;

continuations.text: inni lubbuu kee ni eega;

verses.text: Waaqayyo ammaa jalqabee

continuations.text: hamma bara baraatti, baʼuu fi galuu kee ni eega.

verses.text: Yommuu isaan, “Kottu gara mana Waaqayyoo dhaqnaa”

continuations.text: naan jedhanitti, ani nan gammade.

verses.text: Yaa Yerusaalem,

continuations.text: miilli keenya karrawwan kee irra dhaabata.

verses.text: Yerusaalem akka magaalaa walitti maxxantee

continuations.text: gobbatte tokkootti ijaaramte.

verses.text: Kunis iddoo gosoonni,

continuations.text: gosoonni Waaqayyo,
akka sirna Israaʼeliif kenname sanaatti,
maqaa Waaqayyoo galateeffachuuf itti ol baʼanii dha.

verses.text: Teessoowwan murtii,

continuations.text: teessoowwan mana Daawit achi dhaabatu.

verses.text: Akkana jedhaa nagaa Yerusaalemiif kadhadhaa:

continuations.text: “Warri si jaallatan nagaan haa jiraatan.

verses.text: Dallaa kee keessa nagaan,

continuations.text: masaraa mootummaa keetii keessa immoo tasgabbiin haa jiraatu.”

verses.text: Ani obboloota kootii fi michoota kootiif jedhee,

continuations.text: “Nagaan si keessa haa jiraatu” nan jedha.

verses.text: Mana Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaatiif jedhee,

continuations.text: ani akka wanni gaariin siif taʼu nan hawwa.

verses.text: Yaa isa teessoon kee samii irra jiru,

continuations.text: ani ija koo gara keetti ol nan qabadha.

verses.text: Akkuma iji garbootaa harka gooftaa isaanii,

continuations.text: iji garbittii immoo harka giiftii ishee ilaalu sana,
hamma inni araara nuu buusutti,
iji keenyas gara Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaa ni ilaala.

verses.text: Nuu araarami; yaa Waaqayyo, nuu araarami;

continuations.text: tuffatamuun nutti baayʼateeraatii.

verses.text: Arrabni warra of jajaniitii fi

continuations.text: tuffiin warra of tuulanii nutti baayʼateera.

verses.text: Israaʼel akkana haa jedhu:

continuations.text: Utuu Waaqayyo garee keenya taʼuu baatee,

verses.text: utuu Waaqayyo garee keenya taʼuu baatee,

continuations.text: yommuu namoonni nutti kaʼanitti,

verses.text: yommuu aariin isaanii nutti bobaʼetti,

continuations.text: silaa isaan utuu nu lubbuun jirruu nu liqimsu turan;

verses.text: lolaan nu liqimsee

continuations.text: dhaʼaan bishaanii nurra yaaʼa ture;

verses.text: bishaan hamaan

continuations.text: nu fudhatee bada ture.

verses.text: Waaqayyo akka nu ilkaan isaaniitiin cicciramnuuf

continuations.text: dabarsee itti nu hin kennin sun haa eebbifamu.

verses.text: Akkuma simbirri kiyyoo adamsituu jalaa baatu,

continuations.text: nu isaan jalaa baaneerra;
kiyyoon ni ciccite;
nus jalaa baane.

verses.text: Gargaarsi keenya maqaa Waaqayyoo,

continuations.text: Uumaa samii fi lafa sanaa ti.

verses.text: Warri Waaqayyoon amanatan akka Tulluu Xiyoon

continuations.text: kan hin raafamne, kan bara baraan jiraatu sanaa ti.

verses.text: Akkuma tulluuwwan Yerusaalemin marsan sana,

continuations.text: Waaqayyo ammaa jalqabee hamma bara baraatti,
saba isaa ni marsa.

verses.text: Akka qajeeltonni jalʼina hojjechuuf

continuations.text: harka isaanii ol hin diriirfanneef,
bokkuun hamootaa lafa qajeeltotaaf
ixaadhaan qoodame irra hin jiraatu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, warra gaariif,

continuations.text: warra garaa isaaniitiin toloota taʼaniifis waan gaarii godhi.

verses.text: Warra karaa micciiramaatti garagalan garuu,

continuations.text: Waaqayyo akkuma warra hammina hojjetan balleessu jaras ni balleessa.
Nagaan Israaʼeliif haa taʼu.

verses.text: Yeroo Waaqayyo warra boojiʼamanii turan gara Xiyoonitti deebisetti,

continuations.text: nu akka warra abjuu abjootanii taane.

verses.text: Afaan keenya kolfaan, arrabni keenya immoo

continuations.text: faarfannaa gammachuutiin guutame.
Kana irratti saboota gidduutti,
“Waaqayyo waan guddaa isaaniif godheera” jedhame.

verses.text: Waaqayyo waan guddaa nuuf godhe;

continuations.text: nus ni gammanne.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma lagoota Negeeb,

continuations.text: boojuu keenya nuu deebisi.

verses.text: Warri imimmaaniin facaasan,

continuations.text: faarfannaa gammachuutiin ni haammatu.

verses.text: Namni sanyii facaafamu baadhatee booʼaa gad baʼu,

continuations.text: bissii isaa baadhatee faarfannaa gammachuu faarfachaa deebiʼa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo mana ijaaruu baannaan,

continuations.text: warri ijaaran akkasumaan dadhabu.
Waaqayyo magaalaa eeguu baannaan,
warri eegan akkasumaan dhaabachaa bulu.

verses.text: Isin buddeena dadhabbii guddaan argame nyaachuuf jettanii,

continuations.text: barii barraaqaan kaʼuun keessan,
turtanii rafuun keessan faayidaa hin qabu;
inni warra jaallatuuf utuma isaan rafanii iyyuu // waan isaan barbaachisu ni kennaaf.

verses.text: Kunoo, ijoolleen kennaa Waaqayyoo ti;

continuations.text: iji gadameessaas badhaasa isaa ti.

verses.text: Ijoolleen dargaggummaa keessa dhalchan,

continuations.text: akkuma xiyya harka goota tokkoo keessa jiruu ti.

verses.text: Namni korojoon isaa xiyyaan guutame eebbifamaa dha.

continuations.text: Inni yommuu karra duratti diinota isaatiin falmutti hin qaanaʼu.

verses.text: Warri Waaqayyoon sodaatan,

continuations.text: kanneen karaa isaa irra deeman eebbifamoo dha.

verses.text: Ati buʼaa dadhabbii keetii ni nyaatta;

continuations.text: ni eebbifamta; jireenyis sitti tola.

verses.text: Niitiin kee mana kee keessatti,

continuations.text: akka muka wayinii kan ija naqatee ni taati;
ijoolleen kees naannoo maaddii keetiitti,
akka lataa muka ejersaa ni taʼu.

verses.text: Namni Waaqayyoon sodaatu

continuations.text: akkasitti eebbifama.

verses.text: Bara jireenya keetii guutuu,

continuations.text: Waaqayyo Xiyoon irraa si haa eebbisu;
atis badhaadhummaa Yerusaalem argi.

verses.text: ijoollee ijoollee keetii ni argi;

continuations.text: nagaan Israaʼeliif haa taʼu.

verses.text: Israaʼel akkana haa jedhu;

continuations.text: “Isaan dargaggummaa kootii jalqabanii akka malee na cunqursaniiru;

verses.text: isaan dargaggummaa kootii jalqabanii akka malee na cunqursaniiru;

continuations.text: garuu na hin moʼanne.

verses.text: Warri qootiisa qotan dugda koo qotan;

continuations.text: boʼoo isaaniis ni dheeressan.

verses.text: Waaqayyo garuu qajeelaa dha;

continuations.text: funyoo jalʼootaa gargar kukkuteera.”

verses.text: Warri Xiyoonin jibban hundinuu,

continuations.text: qaaniidhaan duubatti haa deebiʼan.

verses.text: Isaan akka marga bantii manaa irraa

continuations.text: kan utuu hin guddatin goguu haa taʼan;

verses.text: namichi haamu qabaa isaa guuttachuu,

continuations.text: yookaan namichi walitti qabu bissii isaa guuttachuu hin dandaʼu.

verses.text: Warri achiin darban, “Eebbi Waaqayyoo isiniif haa taʼu;

continuations.text: maqaa Waaqayyootiin isin eebbifna” isaaniin hin jedhin.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani boolla gad fagoo keessaa // sitti nan iyyadha;
yaa Gooftaa, sagalee koo dhagaʼi.

continuations.text: Gurri kees sagalee waammata koo
xiyyeeffatee haa dhagaʼu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, utuu ati cubbuu lakkooftee,

continuations.text: yaa gooftaa silaa eenyutu dhaabachuu dandaʼa?

verses.text: Garuu dhiifamni si bira jira;

continuations.text: kanaaf ati ni sodaatamta.

verses.text: Ani Waaqayyoon nan eeggadha; lubbuun koos isa eeggatti;

continuations.text: dubbii isaas nan abdadha.

verses.text: Eegdota barii lafaa eeggatan caalaa,

continuations.text: dhugumaan eegdota barii lafaa eeggatan caalaa
lubbuun koo Gooftaa eeggatti.

verses.text: Yaa Israaʼel, ati Waaqayyoon abdadhu;

continuations.text: Waaqayyo bira jaalalli dhuma hin qabne,
furiin guutuunis ni jiraatii.

verses.text: Inni mataan isaa cubbuu isaanii

continuations.text: hundumaa irraa Israaʼelin ni fura.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, garaan koo of hin jaju;

continuations.text: iji koos of hin tuulu;
ani waan guddaa fi waan humna kootii ol taʼe keessa hin seenu.

verses.text: Ani garuu lubbuu koo afaan qabachiiseera; calʼisiiseeras;

continuations.text: akkuma daaʼimni harma haadha isaa guusan tokko haadhatti irkatee boqotu sana,
akkuma daaʼima harma haadha isaa guusanii lubbuun koo na keessatti calʼiste.

verses.text: Yaa Israaʼel, ammaa fi bara baraaf,

continuations.text: Waaqayyoon abdadhu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, Daawitii fi

continuations.text: rakkina inni obse hundumaa yaadadhu.

verses.text: Inni kakuu tokko Waaqayyoof kakatee

continuations.text: Waaqa Yaaqoob Jabaa sanaaf akkana jedhee wareege:

verses.text: “Ani mana koo ol hin seenu;

continuations.text: yookaan siree kootti ol hin baʼu.

verses.text: Ani ija kootiif hirriba,

continuations.text: baallee ija kootiitiif immoo mugaatii hin eeyyamu;

verses.text: kunis hamma ani Waaqayyoof iddoo argutti,

continuations.text: Waaqa Yaaqoob Jabaa sanaaf iddoo jireenyaa argutti.”

verses.text: Kunoo, Efraataatti waaʼee isaa dhageenye;

continuations.text: Yaaʼaarittis isa arganne:

verses.text: “Kottaa iddoo jireenya isaa dhaqnaa;

continuations.text: ejjeta miilla isaa jalattis kufnee waaqeffannaa.

verses.text: ‘Yaa Waaqayyo kaʼiitii, gara iddoo boqonnaa keetii kottu;

continuations.text: atii fi taabonni jabina keetiis kottaa.

verses.text: Luboonni kee qajeelummaa haa uffatan;

continuations.text: qulqulloonni kees gammachuudhaan haa faarfatan.’ ”

verses.text: Sababii garbicha kee Daawitiif jedhiitii,

continuations.text: dibamaa kee hin gatin.

verses.text: Waaqayyo akkana jedhee kakuu dhugaa tokko Daawitiif kakateera;

continuations.text: inni kakuu kana irraa duubatti hin deebiʼu:
“Ani ilmaan kee keessaa isa tokko teessoo kee irra nan teessisa;

verses.text: yoo ilmaan kee kakuu koo fi seera ani isaan barsiisu eegan,

continuations.text: ilmaan isaaniis akkasuma bara baraa hamma bara baraatti // teessoo kee irra ni taaʼu.”

verses.text: Waaqayyo Xiyoonin filateeraatii;

continuations.text: akka isheen iddoo jireenya isaa taatus fedhee akkana jedheera:

verses.text: “Kun bara baraa hamma bara baraatti iddoo jireenyaa koo ti;

continuations.text: kanas ani waanan fedheef, as nan jiraadha.

verses.text: Ani waan hundaan ishee nan eebbisa;

continuations.text: hiyyeeyyii ishee illee buddeena nan quubsa.

verses.text: Luboota isheetti fayyina nan uffisa;

continuations.text: qulqulloonni ishees gammachuudhaan ni faarfatu.

verses.text: “Ani achitti akka gaanfi tokko Daawitiif biqilu nan godha;

continuations.text: dibamaa koofis ibsaa qopheesseera.

verses.text: Diinota isaatti qaanii nan uffisa;

continuations.text: gonfoon mataa isaa irraa garuu ni ifa.”

verses.text: Obboloonni tokkummaadhaan walii wajjin jiraachuun,

continuations.text: akkam gaarii dha! Akkam namatti tolas!

verses.text: Kun akka zayitii gatii guddaa

continuations.text: kan mataa irratti dhangalaafamee,
akka isa areeda irra gad yaaʼuu,
areeda Aroon irra, morma uffata isaa irras gad yaaʼa ti.

verses.text: Innis akkuma fixeensa Hermoon,

continuations.text: kan Tulluu Xiyoon irra gad yaaʼuu ti.
Achi irratti Waaqayyo hamma bara baraatti eebba isaa,
jireenyas ajajeeraatii.

verses.text: Isin tajaajiltoonni Waaqayyoo,

continuations.text: warri halkan mana Waaqayyoo keessa tajaajiltan hundinuu,
Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Mana qulqullummaa keessatti harka keessan ol qabaatii

continuations.text: Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo samii fi lafa uume sun

continuations.text: Xiyoon irraa isin haa eebbisu.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Maqaa Waaqayyoo jajadhaa;
isin garboonni Waaqayyoo isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Isin warri mana Waaqayyoo keessa,

continuations.text: oobdii mana Waaqa keenyaa keessa tajaajiltan, isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo gaariidhaatii, Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa;

continuations.text: inni arjaadhaatii maqaa isaatiif faarfadhaa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo Yaaqoobin ofii isaatiif,

continuations.text: Israaʼelin immoo dhaala dhuunfaa isaa godhee filateeraatii.

verses.text: Ani akka Waaqayyo guddaa taʼe,

continuations.text: akka Gooftaan keenya waaqota hunda caalaa guddaa taʼe beeka.

verses.text: Waaqayyo samiiwwan keessattii fi lafa irratti,

continuations.text: galaanotaa fi tuujuba isaanii hunda keessatti,
waan isa gammachiisu kam iyyuu ni hojjeta.

verses.text: Inni akka duumessoonni daarii lafaatii kaʼan ni godha;

continuations.text: bokkaa wajjin balaqqee erga;
gombisaa isaa keessaas bubbee gad baasa.

verses.text: Inni hangafoota Gibxi,

continuations.text: kan namaatii fi kan horii ni dhaʼe.

verses.text: Yaa Gibxi, inni gidduu keetti,

continuations.text: Faraʼoonii fi tajaajiltoota isaa hundatti mallattoo fi dinqii isaa ergeera.

verses.text: Inni saboota baayʼee dhaʼee

continuations.text: mootota jajjaboo ajjeese;

verses.text: Sihoon mootii warra Amoorotaa,

continuations.text: Oogi mootii Baashaanii fi mootota Kanaʼaan hunda ni ajjeese;

verses.text: lafa isaanii dhaala godhee

continuations.text: akka dhaala isaanii taʼuufis saba isaa Israaʼeliif kenne.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, maqaan kee bara baraan jiraata;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqayyo, ati dhaloota hunda keessatti ni yaadatamta.

verses.text: Waaqayyo saba isaatiif ni falma;

continuations.text: tajaajiltoota isaatiifis garaa laafa.

verses.text: Waaqonni tolfamoon namoota ormaa meetii fi

continuations.text: warqee harka namaatiin hojjetamanii dha.

verses.text: Isaan afaan qabu; garuu dubbachuu hin dandaʼan;

continuations.text: ijas qabu; garuu arguu hin dandaʼan;

verses.text: gurra qabu; garuu dhagaʼuu hin dandaʼan;

continuations.text: yookaan hafuurri tokko iyyuu afaan isaanii keessa hin jiru.

verses.text: Warri isaan tolchan kanneen isaan amanatan hundi

continuations.text: akkuma isaanii taʼu.

verses.text: Yaa mana Israaʼel Waaqayyoon eebbisaa;

continuations.text: yaa mana Aroon Waaqayyoon eebbisaa;

verses.text: yaa mana Lewwii Waaqayyoon eebbisaa;

continuations.text: isin warri isa sodaattanis, Waaqayyoon eebbisaa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo inni Yerusaalem keessa jiraatu sun,

continuations.text: Xiyoon irraa haa eebbifamu.
Haalleluuyaa!

verses.text: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; inni gaariidhaatii.

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Waaqa waaqotaatiif galata galchaa.

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Gooftaa Gooftotaatiif galata galchaa:

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni kophaa isaa dinqii gurguddaa hojjeta;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni ogummaa isaatiin samiiwwan uume;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni bishaanota irratti lafa diriirse;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni ifa gurguddaa hojjete;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni akka biiftuun guyyaa mootu godhe;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni akka jiʼii fi urjiiwwan halkan moʼan godhe;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni hangafa Gibxi dhaʼe;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni isaan gidduudhaa Israaʼelin baase;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: harka jabaa fi irree diriiraadhaan Israaʼelin baase;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni Galaana Diimaa iddoo lamatti gargarii qoode;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni galaana gidduudhaan Israaʼelin dabarse;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Faraʼoonii fi loltoota isaa garuu Galaana Diimaatti naqe;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni saba ofii isaa gammoojjii keessa geggeesse;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni mootota gurguddaa dhaʼe;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni mootota jajjaboo fixe;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni Sihoon mootii Amoorotaa ajjeese;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni Oogi mootii Baashaan ajjeese;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni biyya isaanii dhaala godhee kenne;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: dhaala godhee garbicha isaa Israaʼeliif kenne;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Inni yeroo nu gad deebinetti nu yaadate;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni harka diinota keenyaatii nu baase,

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: inni uumama hundaaf soora kenna;

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Waaqa samiitiif galata galchaa.

continuations.text: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.

verses.text: Nu yeroo Xiyoonin yaadannetti,

continuations.text: lageen Baabilon bira teenyee boonye.

verses.text: Achittis kiraara keenya

continuations.text: muka alaltuutti fannifne;

verses.text: achitti warri nu boojiʼan faarfannaa, warri nu dhiphisanis,

continuations.text: “Faarfannaawwan Xiyoon keessaa tokko nuu faarfadhaa!”
jedhanii akka nu faarfannaa gammachuu isaaniif faarfannu nu gaafatan.

verses.text: Nu utuu biyya ormaa jirruu,

continuations.text: akkamitti faarfannaa Waaqayyoo faarfachuu dandeenya?

verses.text: Yaa Yerusaalem, yoo ani si irraanfadhe,

continuations.text: harki koo mirgaa ogummaa isaa haa irraanfatu.

verses.text: Yoo ani si yaadachuu baadhe,

continuations.text: yoo ani gammachuu koo guddichaa olitti
Yerusaalemin ilaaluu baadhe,
arrabni koo laagaa kootti haa maxxanu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, waan warri Edoom

continuations.text: gaafa Yerusaalem diigamte jedhan sana yaadadhu;
isaanis, “Ishee diigaa!
Hamma hundee isheetti ishee diigaa!” jedhanii iyyan.

verses.text: Yaa intala Baabilon, kan baduudhaaf qophoofte,

continuations.text: inni waan ati nu goote sanaaf,
gatii kee siif kennu eebbifamaa dha.

verses.text: Inni daaʼimman kee qabee

continuations.text: dhagaa irratti caccabsu sun eebbifamaa dha.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin galateeffadha;

continuations.text: fuula “waaqotaa” durattis galata kee nan faarfadha.

verses.text: Sababii ati maqaa keetii fi dubbii kee waan hundaa olitti guddifteef,

continuations.text: ani sababii jaalalaa fi amanamummaa keetiitiif
gara mana qulqullummaa kee qulqullichaatti gad jedhee,
maqaa kee nan leellisa.

verses.text: Yeroo ani si waammadhetti ati deebii naa kennite;

continuations.text: irree keetiinis na jabeessite.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, mootonni lafaa hundinuu,

continuations.text: yeroo dubbii afaan keetii dhagaʼanitti si haa leellisan.

verses.text: Ulfinni Waaqayyoo, guddaadhaatii,

continuations.text: isaan waaʼee karaa Waaqayyoo haa faarfatan.

verses.text: Waaqayyo yoo ol fagoo jiraate iyyuu, // nama gad qabame ni ilaala;

continuations.text: nama of tuulu immoo fagootti beeka.

verses.text: Ani rakkina keessa jiraadhu iyyuu,

continuations.text: ati lubbuu koo ni eegda;
aarii diina kootti harka kee ni diriirsita;
harka kee mirgaatiinis na oolchita.

verses.text: Waaqayyo kaayyoo isaa fiixaan naa baasa;

continuations.text: yaa Waaqayyo, jaalalli kee bara baraan jiraata;
hojii harka keetii hin gatin.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati na qorteerta;

continuations.text: na beekteertas.

verses.text: Ati yeroo ani gad taaʼuu fi yeroo ani ol kaʼu ni beekta;

continuations.text: yaada koos fagootti hubatta.

verses.text: Deemuu koo fi ciisuu koo addaan baaftee beekta;

continuations.text: karaa koo hundas beekta.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka dubbiin tokko iyyuu arraba koo hin jirre,

continuations.text: ati guutumaan guutuutti ni beekta.

verses.text: Ati duraa fi duubaan na marsiteerta;

continuations.text: harka kees narra keesseerta.

verses.text: Beekumsi akkanaa anaaf akka malee dinqii dha;

continuations.text: hubachuufis akka malee narraa fagoo dha.

verses.text: Hafuura kee biraa ani eessa dhaquun dandaʼa?

continuations.text: Fuula kee duraas ani eessatti baqachuun dandaʼa?

verses.text: Yoo ani samiiwwanitti ol baʼe, ati achi jirta;

continuations.text: yoo ani siree koo siiʼool keessa dhaabbadhes, achis ni jirta.

verses.text: Yoo ani qoochoo ganamaatiin

continuations.text: barrisee qarqara galaanaa fagoo irra qubadhe,

verses.text: achittis harki kee karaa na argisiisa;

continuations.text: harki kee mirgaas jabeessee na qaba.

verses.text: Yoo ani, “Dhugumaan dukkanni na dhoksa;

continuations.text: ifnis naannoo kootti halkan taʼa” jedhe,

verses.text: dukkanni iyyuu siif dukkana hin taʼu;

continuations.text: halkanis akkuma guyyaa ifa;
dukkanni siif akkuma ifaatii.

verses.text: Ati namummaa koo isa keessaa uumteertaatii;

continuations.text: gadameessa haadha koo keessattis na tolchite.

verses.text: Ani sababii haala sodaachisaa fi dinqisiisaadhaan uumameef

continuations.text: sin galateeffadha;
hojiin kee dinqisiisaa dha;
kanas ani akka gaariittan beeka.

verses.text: Yeroo ani iddoo dhoksaatti uumame,

continuations.text: lafeen koo si duraa hin dhokanne.
Yeroo ani dhidhima lafaa keessatti tolfame,

verses.text: iji kee dhagna koo kan hin tolfamin arge.

continuations.text: Guyyoonni duraan dursanii naaf murteeffaman hundi // utuu hin jiraatin,
kitaaba kee keessatti barreeffamaniiru.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, yaada kee hubachuun akkam ulfaata!

continuations.text: Baayʼinni isaas akkam guddaa dha!

verses.text: Utuu ani isaan lakkaaʼee jiraadhee,

continuations.text: silaa lakkoobsi isaanii cirracha irra baayʼata.
Ani yeroon dammaqutti, amma iyyuu suma wajjinan jira.

verses.text: Maaloo yaa Waaqi, ati utuu hamoota fixxee!

continuations.text: Warri dhiiga namaa dhangalaaftan, narraa fagaadhaa!

verses.text: Isaan yaada hamaadhaan waaʼee kee dubbatu;

continuations.text: diinonni kee akkasumaan maqaa kee dhaʼu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani warra si jibban hin jibbuu?

continuations.text: Warra sitti kaʼanis hin xireeffadhuu?

verses.text: Ani hamma dhumaatti isaan jibbeera;

continuations.text: akka diina koottis isaan nan heda.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, na sakattaʼi; garaa koos beeki;

continuations.text: qoriitii na ilaali; yaada koos beeki.

verses.text: Yoo karaan hamminaa na keessa jiraate mee ilaali;

continuations.text: karaa bara baraa irras na adeemsisi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, namoota hamoo jalaa na baasi;

continuations.text: namoota finciltoota

verses.text: warra garaa isaanii keessatti hammina yaadanii

continuations.text: guyyaa hunda waraana kaasan narraa eegi.

verses.text: Isaan arraba isaanii akkuma bofaa qaratu;

continuations.text: hadhaan buutii hidhii isaanii jala jira.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, harka hamootaa narraa eegi;

continuations.text: namoota finciltoota // warra miilla koo kiyyootti galchuu yaadan jalaa na baasi.

verses.text: Of tuultonni dhoksanii kiyyoo na dura kaaʼaniiru;

continuations.text: ribuu kiyyoo isaanii diriirsaniiru;
karaa koo irras kiyyoo isaanii kaaʼaniiru.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani, “Ati Waaqa koo ti” siin nan jedha.

continuations.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, waammata koo dhagaʼi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, fayyisaa koo jabaa,

continuations.text: ati guyyaa waraanaatti gaachana mataa naa taate.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka fedhiin hamootaa fiixaan baʼu hin godhin;

continuations.text: akka isaan of hin tuulleef, akka karoorri isaanii milkaaʼu hin godhin.

verses.text: Mataan warra na marsanii,

continuations.text: hammina afaan isaaniitii baʼuun haa haguugamu.

verses.text: Barbadaan ibiddaa isaan irra haa buʼu;

continuations.text: isaan ibiddatti illee haa darbataman;
akka lammata hin kaaneefis boolla qileetti haa darbataman.

verses.text: Maqa balleessitoonni lafa irra hin jiraatin;

continuations.text: namni jalʼaan waan hamaadhaan haa badu.

verses.text: Waaqayyo rakkattootaaf falmee

continuations.text: hiyyeeyyiif illee murtii qajeelaa akka kennu ani beeka.

verses.text: Dhugumaan namni qajeelaan maqaa kee ni galateeffata;

continuations.text: namni tolaanis fuula kee dura ni jiraata.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani sin waammadha; dafii na qaqqabi.

continuations.text: Yommuu ani si waammadhus sagalee koo dhagaʼi.

verses.text: Kadhannaan koo fuula kee duratti akka ixaanaatti anaaf haa fudhatamu;

continuations.text: harka koo ol qabachuun koos akka aarsaa galgalaa anaaf haa taʼu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, afaan kootiif eegduu naa dhaabi;

continuations.text: balbala afaan kootiis naa eegi.

verses.text: Garaan koo namoota waan hamaa hojjetan wajjin,

continuations.text: hojii hamminaa keessatti hirmaachuuf,
gara jalʼina kamiitti iyyuu hin harkifamin;
akka ani nyaata isaanii miʼaawaa nyaadhus anaaf hin eeyyamin.

verses.text: Namni qajeelaan na haa rukutu; kun gara laafinaatii;

continuations.text: inni ana haa ifatu; kunis zayitii mataa koo irraatti.
Mataan koo waan kana hin didu.
Taʼus kadhannaan koo yoom iyyuu hojii hamootaatiin mormuu dha.

verses.text: Bulchitoonni isaanii ededa boollaa irraa gad ni darbatamu;

continuations.text: isaan dubbii koo ni dhagaʼu; dubbiin koo ni miʼaawaatii.

verses.text: Isaanis, “Akkuma namni lafa qotu biyyoo bulleessu sana,

continuations.text: lafeen keenya afaan siiʼool irratti bittinneeffamee jira” jedhu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, ani garuu ija koo sirraa hin buqqifadhu;

continuations.text: ani kooluu sitti galeera; dabarsitee duʼatti na hin kennin.

verses.text: Kiyyoo isaan naaf kaaʼan irraa,

continuations.text: kiyyoo warri jalʼina hojjetan naaf qopheessan irraas na eegi.

verses.text: Warri hamoon kiyyoo ofii isaaniitiin haa qabaman;

continuations.text: ani garuu nagumaan nan baʼa.

heading: Akka Qananii Jaldhootaatiin Hin fudhatamne Waaqa Kadhachuu
Faarfannaa Daawit.

verses.text: Ani gara Waaqayyotti nan iyya;

continuations.text: sagalee kootiinis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti // waammata koo nan dhiʼeeffadha.

verses.text: Ani guungummii koo fuula isaa duratti nan dhangalaasa;

continuations.text: dhibee koos fuula isaa duratti nan himadha.

verses.text: Yeroof hafuurri koo na keessatti laafu,

continuations.text: situ karaa koo beeka.
Namoonni daandii ani deemu irra,
kiyyoo naa kaaʼaniiru.

verses.text: Gara mirga koo ilaali; argis;

continuations.text: namni naa yaadu tokko iyyuu hin jiru;
ani iddoon itti kooluu galu tokko illee hin qabu;
namni jireenya kootiif yaadus hin jiru.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, sitti nan iyyadha;

continuations.text: “Ati iddoo ani itti kooluu galuu dha;
biyya warra jiraatoo keessattis ati qooda koo ti” nan jedha.

verses.text: Ani abdii kutadheeraatii,

continuations.text: kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi;
warra na ariʼatan jalaa na baasi;
isaan akka malee natti cimaniiruutii.

verses.text: Akka ani maqaa kee galateeffadhuuf,

continuations.text: lubbuu koo mana hidhaatii naa baasi.
Sababii ati waan gaarii naa gooteef,
qajeeltonni naannoo kootti walitti qabamu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi;

continuations.text: gurra kees gara waammata kootiitti deebisi;
amanamummaa fi
qajeelummaa keetiin, na gargaari.

verses.text: Ati garbicha kee murtiitti hin dhiʼeessin;

continuations.text: namni lubbuun jiraatu kam iyyuu fuula kee duratti qajeelaa mitiitii.

verses.text: Diinni lubbuu koo ariʼachaa jiraatii;

continuations.text: jireenya koos butuchee biyyootti make.
Akkuma warra dur duʼaniittis
dukkana keessa na jiraachiseera.

verses.text: Kanaafuu hafuurri koo na keessatti gaggabeera;

continuations.text: onneen koos na keessatti rifatteerti.

verses.text: Ani guyyoota durii nan yaadadha;

continuations.text: waan ati hojjette hundas irra deddeebiʼee nan yaada;
waan harki kee hojjete illee nan heda.

verses.text: Harka koo gara keetti nan diriirfadha;

continuations.text: lubbuun koos akkuma lafa gogaa si dheebotti.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, dafii deebii naa kenni;

continuations.text: hafuurri koo dadhabeera.
Fuula kee na duraa hin dhoksin
yookaan ani akka warra boolla buʼanii nan taʼa.

verses.text: Ani waanan si amanadheef,

continuations.text: akka ani ganama ganama oduu jaalala keetii dhagaʼu godhi.
Ani lubbuu koo gara keetti ol nan kaasaatii,
karaa ani irra deemuu qabu natti argisiisi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani akka ati na dhoksituuf // sitti nan baqadhaatii,

continuations.text: diinota koo jalaa na baasi.

verses.text: Ati sababii Waaqa koo taateef,

continuations.text: akka ani fedhii kee guutu na barsiisi;
hafuurri kee gaariin sun
karaa wal qixxee irra na haa qajeelchu.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, maqaa keetii jedhiitii lubbuu koo jiraachisi;

continuations.text: qajeelummaa keetiinis rakkina keessaa na baasi.

verses.text: Ati sababii na jaallattuuf diinota koo fixi;

continuations.text: waan ani garbicha kee taʼeef,
warra na cunqursan hunda barbadeessi.

verses.text: Waaqayyo kattaa koo,

continuations.text: isa harka koo waraanaaf,
quba koos lolaaf leenjisu sanaaf galanni haa gaʼu.

verses.text: Inni Waaqa na jaallatuu fi daʼoo koo ti;

continuations.text: iddoo ani itti daʼadhuu fi fayyisaa koo ti.
Gaachana koo, iddoo ani itti kooluu galu,
kan na jalatti saba naaf bulchuu dha.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka ati waaʼee isaa yaadduuf, namni maali?

continuations.text: Akka ati isaaf yaadduuf ilmi namaa maali?

verses.text: Namni akkuma qilleensa shuf jedhee darbuuti,

continuations.text: barri isaas akkuma gaaddisa darbuu ti.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, samiiwwan kee tarsaasii gad buʼi;

continuations.text: akka aarri isaan keessaa yaaʼuufis tulluuwwan tuqi.

verses.text: Bakakkaa ergiitii diina bittinneessi;

continuations.text: xiyya kee darbadhuutii isaan balleessi.

verses.text: Ol gubbaadhaa harka kee gad hiixadhuutii

continuations.text: bishaan jabaa jalaa,
harka alagaa duraas,
na baasi; na oolchis;

verses.text: warra afaan isaanii sobaan guutame,

continuations.text: warra harki isaanii mirgaa nama dogoggorsu duraa na baasi.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqi, ani faarfannaa haaraa siif nan faarfadha;

continuations.text: kiraara ribuu kudhaniitiinis siifin weeddisa;

verses.text: isa moototaaf moʼannoo kennuuf, isa garbicha isaa Daawitin

continuations.text: goraadee nama ajjeesu jalaa baasuuf nan faarfadha.

verses.text: Harka Ormootaa duraa,

continuations.text: warra afaan isaanii sobaan guutame,
warra harki isaanii mirgaa
nama dogoggorsu jalaa na baasi; na oolchis.

verses.text: Ilmaan keenya dargaggummaa isaanii keessatti,

continuations.text: akka biqiltuu tolee guddatee haa taʼan;
intallan keenyas akka utubaa golee,
kan masaraa mootummaa miidhagsuuf // soofamee haa taʼan.

verses.text: Gombisaawwan keenya,

continuations.text: midhaan gosa garaa garaatiin haa guutaman.
Hoolonni keenya kumaatama haa dhalan;
dirree keenya irrattis kumaatama kudhaniin // haa baayʼatan;

verses.text: loon keenya haa dorroban hin gatatin

continuations.text: yookaan yeroo malee hin dhalin;
boojiʼamuunis hin jiraatin;
wawwaachuunis karaa keenya irratti hin dhagaʼamin.

verses.text: Warri eebbi kun taʼeef haa gammadan;

continuations.text: warri Waaqayyo Waaqa isaanii taʼeef eebbifamoo dha.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqa koo Mooticha, ani sin leellisa;

continuations.text: bara baraa hamma bara baraattis maqaa kee nan galateeffadha.

verses.text: Ani guyyuma guyyaan sin galateeffadha;

continuations.text: bara baraa hamma bara baraattis maqaa kee nan leellisa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo guddaa dha; galateeffamuunis baayʼee malaaf;

continuations.text: guddina isaa qoratanii itti baʼuun hin dandaʼamu.

verses.text: Dhaloonni tokko dhaloota biraatti hojii kee ni hima;

continuations.text: hojiiwwan kee jajjaboos ni labsa.

verses.text: Isaanis waaʼee miidhagina ulfina qabeessa // surraa kee sanaa ni dubbatu;

continuations.text: anis waaʼee hojii kee dinqisiisaa sanaa irra deddeebiʼee // itti nan yaada.

verses.text: Isaan waaʼee hojii kee sodaachisaa sanaa ni odeessu;

continuations.text: anis guddina kee nan labsa.

verses.text: Isaan yaadannoo gaarummaa keetii baayʼisanii odeessu;

continuations.text: waaʼee qajeelummaa keetiis ililchanii faarfatu.

verses.text: Waaqayyo arjaa fi gara laafessa;

continuations.text: inni aaruuf hin ariifatu; jaalalli isaas baayʼee dha.

verses.text: Waaqayyo, nama hundaaf gaarii dha;

continuations.text: inni waan uume hundaaf garaa ni laafa.

verses.text: Yaa Waaqayyo, hojiin kee hundinuu si galateeffata;

continuations.text: qulqulloonni kees si leellisu.

verses.text: Isaan waaʼee ulfina mootummaa keetii ni odeessu;

continuations.text: waaʼee humna keetiis ni dubbatu;

verses.text: kunis akka namoonni hundi hojii kee humna qabeessa,

continuations.text: surraa ulfina qabeessa mootummaa kee sanaas beekaniif.

verses.text: Mootummaan kee mootummaa bara baraa ti;

continuations.text: bulchiinsi kees dhalootaa gara dhalootaatti darba.
Waaqayyo dubbii isaa hundaan amanamaa dha;
hojii isaa hundaanis arjaa dha.

verses.text: Waaqayyo warra kufan hunda ol qaba;

continuations.text: warra gad qabaman hundas ni kaasa.

verses.text: Iji nama hundaa si eeggata;

continuations.text: atis yeroo barbaachisutti nyaata isaaniif ni kennita.

verses.text: Ati harka kee balʼiftee

continuations.text: fedhii warra lubbuu qaban hundaa ni guutta.

verses.text: Waaqayyo karaa isaa hundaan qajeelaa dha;

continuations.text: hojii isaa hundaanis arjaa dha.

verses.text: Waaqayyo warra isa waammatan hundatti,

continuations.text: warra dhugaadhaan isa waammatan hundatti dhiʼoo dha.

verses.text: Inni fedhii warra isa sodaatanii ni guuta;

continuations.text: kadhannaa isaanis dhagaʼee isaan oolcha.

verses.text: Waaqayyo warra isa jaallatan hunda ni eega;

continuations.text: jalʼoota hunda garuu ni balleessa.

verses.text: Afaan koo Waaqayyoon galateeffachuudhaan ni dubbata.

continuations.text: Uumamni hundinuu maqaa isaa qulqulluu sana
bara baraa hamma bara baraatti haa eebbisu.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Yaa lubbuu ko, Waaqayyoon galateeffadhu.

verses.text: Ani bara jireenya koo guutuu Waaqayyoon nan galateeffadha;

continuations.text: ani hamman jirutti Waaqaaf nan faarfadha.

verses.text: Abdii keessan bulchitoota irra,

continuations.text: namoota duʼa hin oolle // warra isin gargaaruu hin dandeenye irra hin kaaʼatinaa.

verses.text: Isaan yeruma lubbuun isaan keessaa baatu gara lafaatti deebiʼu;

continuations.text: guyyuma sanas karoorri isaanii bada.

verses.text: Namni gargaarsi isaa Waaqa Yaaqoob taʼe, kan abdiin isaas

continuations.text: Waaqayyo Waaqa isaa taʼe eebbifamaa dha.

verses.text: Waaqayyo Uumaa samii fi lafaa,

continuations.text: galaanaa fi waan isaan keessa jiru hundaa ti;
inni bara baraan amanamaa taʼe jiraata.

verses.text: Inni warra cunqurfamaniif ni mura;

continuations.text: warra beelaʼaniif nyaata kenna.
Waaqayyo warra hidhaman illee ni hiika;

verses.text: Waaqayyo jaamotaaf agartuu ni kenna;

continuations.text: Waaqayyo warra gad deebiʼan ol qaba;
Waaqayyo qajeeltota ni jaallata.

verses.text: Waaqayyo alagaadhaaf eegumsa ni godha;

continuations.text: ijoollee haadhaa fi abbaa hin qabnee fi
dubartoota dhirsoonni irraa duʼan ni jiraachisa;
karaa jalʼootaa garuu ni balleessa.

verses.text: Waaqayyo bara baraan ni moʼa;

continuations.text: Yaa Xiyoon, Waaqni kee dhaloota hundaaf mootii taʼa.
Haalleluuyaa.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Faarfannaadhaan Waaqa galateeffachuun akkam gaarii dha;
isa galateeffachuun akkam gammachiisaa fi kan maluu dha!

verses.text: Waaqayyo Yerusaalemin ni ijaara;

continuations.text: Israaʼeloota boojiʼamanis walitti qaba.

verses.text: Warra garaan cabe ni fayyisa;

continuations.text: madaa isaaniis walitti hodha.

verses.text: Inni baayʼina urjiiwwanii ni beeka;

continuations.text: tokkoo tokkoo isaaniis maqaa maqaadhaan waama.

verses.text: Gooftaan keenya guddaa dha; humni isaas jabaa dha;

continuations.text: hubannaan isaas dhuma hin qabu.

verses.text: Waaqayyo warra gad qabaman ni jiraachisa;

continuations.text: hamoota garuu lafatti darbata.

verses.text: Galata galchaa Waaqayyoon faarfadhaa;

continuations.text: baganaadhaanis Waaqa keenyaaf weeddisaa.

verses.text: Inni samiiwwani duumessaan haguuga;

continuations.text: lafaafis bokkaa kenna;
tulluuwwan irrattis marga biqilcha.

verses.text: Horiidhaaf waan isaan dheedan,

continuations.text: yommuu ilmaan arraagessaa iyyanitti // nyaata isaaniif ni kenna.

verses.text: Inni jabina fardaatti hin gammadu;

continuations.text: yookaan miilli namaa isa hin gammachiisu;

verses.text: Waaqayyo warra isa sodaatanitti,

continuations.text: warra araara isaa abdatanitti ni gammada.

verses.text: Yaa Yerusaalem, Waaqayyoon galateeffadhu;

continuations.text: Yaa Xiyoon Waaqa kee galateeffadhu.

verses.text: Inni danqaraa karra keetii ni jabeessaatii;

continuations.text: ijoollee kees si keessatti eebbisa.

verses.text: Daarii keetiif nagaa kenna;

continuations.text: qamadii qulqulluudhaanis si quubsa.

verses.text: Inni ajaja isaa gara lafaatti ni erga;

continuations.text: dubbiin isaas ni ariifata.

verses.text: Inni cabbii akkuma suufiitti diriirsa;

continuations.text: qorras akkuma daaraatti bittinneessa.

verses.text: Dhagaa cabbii akkuma cirrachaa gad darbata.

continuations.text: Dhaamocha isaa dura eenyutu dhaabachuu dandaʼa?

verses.text: Inni dubbii isaa ergee isaan baqsa;

continuations.text: bubbee isaa ni kaasa; bishaanonnis ni yaaʼu.

verses.text: Inni dubbii isaa Yaaqoobitti,

continuations.text: seeraa fi sirna isaa immoo Israaʼelitti mulʼiseera.

verses.text: Waan kana saba biraa tokkoof iyyuu hin goone;

continuations.text: isaan seera isaa hin beekan.
Haalleluuyaa.

heading: Faarfannaa Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuuf Faarfatame

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Samiiwwan irraa Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa;
ol gubbaatti isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Ergamoonni isaa hundinuu isa galateeffadhaa;

continuations.text: raayyaan isaa hundinuus isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Aduu fi jiʼi isa galateeffadhaa;

continuations.text: urjiiwwan ibsitan hundinuus isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Samiiwwan samii isa galateeffadhaa;

continuations.text: bishaanonni samiin ol jirtanis isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Isaan maqaa Waaqayyoo haa galateeffatan;

continuations.text: inni ajajnaan, isaan uumamaniitii.

verses.text: Inni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti isaan dhaabeera;

continuations.text: seera hin geeddaramnes isaaniif kenneera.

verses.text: Uumamawwan galaanaatii fi tuujubawwan hundi,

continuations.text: lafa irraa Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa;

verses.text: bakakkaa fi dhagaan cabbii, cabbii fi duumessi,

continuations.text: bubbeen jabaan ajaja isaa raawwatan,

verses.text: tulluuwwanii fi gaarran hundinuu,

continuations.text: mukkeen ija naqatanii fi birbirsi hundinuu,

verses.text: bineensonnii fi loon hundinuu,

continuations.text: uumamawwan xixinnoo fi simbirroonni barrisan,

verses.text: mootonni lafaatii fi saboonni hundinuu,

continuations.text: ilmaan moototaatii fi bulchitoonni lafaa hundinuu,

verses.text: dargaggoonnii fi shamarran,

continuations.text: jaarsolii fi daaʼimman isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Maqaan isaa qofti ol ol jedheeraatii,

continuations.text: isaan maqaa Waaqayyoo haa galateeffatan;
ulfinni isaas lafaa fi samiiwwanii ol jira.

verses.text: Inni saba isaatiif gaanfa ol kaaseera;

continuations.text: kunis qulqulloota isaa hundaaf,
saba Israaʼel warra isatti dhiʼoo jiran hundaaf ulfina.
Haalleluuyaa.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Faarfannaa haaraa Waaqayyoof faarfadhaa;
waldaa qulqullootaa keessatti illee isa jajadhaa.

verses.text: Israaʼel Uumaa isaatti haa gammadu;

continuations.text: sabni Xiyoon Mootii isaatti haa gammadu.

verses.text: Maqaa isaas shuubbisuudhaan haa jajatu;

continuations.text: dibbee fi baganaadhaan isaaf haa faarfatu.

verses.text: Waaqayyo saba isaatti ni gammadaatii;

continuations.text: warra gad of qabanis fayyina gonfachiisa.

verses.text: Qulqulloonni ulfina kanatti haa gammadan;

continuations.text: siree isaanii irrattis gammachuudhaan haa faarfatan.

verses.text: Galanni Waaqaa afaan isaanii keessa haa jiraatu;

continuations.text: goraadeen afaan lamaas harka isaanii keessa haa jiraattu;

verses.text: kunis sabootatti haaloo baʼuu fi

continuations.text: namoota adabuudhaaf;

verses.text: mootota isaanii foncaan,

continuations.text: hangafoota isaaniis funyoo sibiilaatiin hidhuudhaaf,

verses.text: murtii barreeffame sana isaan irratti dhugaa baʼuudhaaf.

continuations.text: Kunis amanamtoota isaa hundaaf ulfina.
Haalleluuyaa.

verses.text: Haalleluuyaa.

continuations.text: Mana qulqullummaa isaa keessatti Waaqa galateeffadhaa;
samiiwwan isaa humna qabeeyyii keessattis isa galateeffadhaa.

verses.text: Hojiiwwan isaa jajjaboo sanaaf isa leellisaa;

continuations.text: guddina isaa hamma hin qabne sanaaf isa leellisaa.

verses.text: Malakata afuufuudhaan isa galateeffadhaa;

continuations.text: baganaa fi kiraaraan isa galateeffadhaa;

verses.text: dibbeedhaan shuubbisaatii isa jajadhaa;

continuations.text: miʼa ribuutii fi ululleedhaan isa jajadhaa.

verses.text: Kilillee sagalee qabuun isa jajadhaa;

continuations.text: kilillee sagalee guddaatiin isa jajadhaa.

verses.text: Wanni hafuura baafatu hundinuu Waaqayyoon haa jajatu.

continuations.text: Haalleluuyaa.
